item.title: Trump afirma que está dispuesto a participar en una reunión trilateral con Xi y Putin
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, declaró el lunes que está dispuesto a participar en una reunión trilateral con el mandatario chino, Xi Jinping, y el presidente ruso, Vladimir Putin, y que ésta podría centrarse en la desnuclearización.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, declaró el lunes que está dispuesto a participar en una reunión trilateral con el mandatario chino, Xi Jinping, y el presidente ruso, Vladimir Putin, y que ésta podría centrarse en la desnuclearización. "La celebraríamos para hablar de armas nucleares y de la desnuclearización", afirmó Trump a periodistas a las puertas de la Casa Blanca. "Si el presidente Xi quiere celebrarla, yo estaría dispuesto", agregó. A primera hora del lunes, el Kremlin había indicado que Putin, Trump y Xi podrían tener una reunión trilateral al margen de la cumbre de la APEC que se celebrará el próximo mes en China, y que la posibilidad de dicha reunión había surgido en las conversaciones.

item.title: Trump's approval falls to record low of 31% as midterms near, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
item.description: President Donald Trump's approval rating fell to a record low as Americans worried about high gasoline prices and appeared ready to punish his Republican Party in the November 3 congressional elections, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump's approval rating fell to a record low as Americans worried about high gasoline prices and appeared ready to punish his Republican Party in the November 3 congressional elections , according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on Monday. Some 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, down a percentage point from two weeks earlier and the lowest level in either of his presidential terms, the four-day poll showed. Asked which party they would vote for if the congressional elections were held today in what is known as a "generic ballot" question, some 47% of registered voters in the nationwide poll picked Democrats and 35% chose Republicans. The 12-point Democratic advantage was the widest over the current election cycle and could bolster Democratic hopes of seizing control of the US House of Representatives and the US Senate. For Republicans, losing control of either chamber could complicate Trump's agenda in the last two years of his term. Generic ballot polls are national polls that provide an overall view of which party poll respondents want to see in charge in Congress. While these polls provide a view of national public sentiment, they do not capture all the nuances of the state-by-state and district-by-district contests that determine control of the Senate and House, contests in which Republicans hold some structural advantages. A Reuters/Ipsos poll two weeks earlier showed Democrats leading Republicans by 7 points, 44% to 37%. Much of the drop in support for Republican congressional candidates was due to a larger share of women saying they would pick Democrats. Some 50% of female voters said they would vote Democratic, compared to 32% eyeing Republican candidates. Men also favored Democrats, but by a smaller margin. Trump's popularity has suffered since he ordered military strikes on Iran in February alongside US ally Israel. The war triggered a surge in gasoline prices, hitting household finances. Some 68% of Americans disapprove of Trump's handling of the economy, including 37% of self-identified Republicans. Voters in the poll picked Democrats over Republicans as the better stewards of the economy, by 40% to 33%. The survey, which was conducted online, gathered responses from 1,679 US adults, including 1,279 registered voters. The poll's results had a margin of error of 2 percentage points for all respondents and 3 points for registered voters.

item.title: Periodista Mario Guevara fue deportado en 2025 y no figura como fundador de “Latinos por Trump”
item.description: El periodista salvadoreño Mario Guevara fue deportado de Estados Unidos en octubre de 2025 y no hay evidencia de que fundara la organización “Latinos por Trump”, contrario a lo que dicen publicaciones en redes sociales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: El periodista salvadoreño Mario Guevara fue deportado de Estados Unidos en octubre de 2025 y no hay evidencia de que fundara la organización “Latinos por Trump”, contrario a lo que dicen publicaciones en redes sociales. Estos son los detalles clave: Algunos ejemplos dicen que Guevara fundó el grupo y que “acaba de ser deportado” tras pasar 110 días bajo custodia del Servicio de Inmigración y Control de Aduanas (ICE). Guevara dijo el 16 de octubre en un mensaje de Facebook que no es fundador de “Latinos por Trump” y que es falso que acabe de ser deportado. Añadió que no tiene relación con la iniciativa y que expresó en línea su simpatía por el Partido Republicano, pero que se opone a las políticas del presidente Donald Trump. Guevara también se refirió a estas publicaciones en septiembre en Instagram . BBC y Los Angeles Times identifican a otra persona, Marco Gutiérrez, como fundador de “Latinos por Trump”. Gutiérrez dijo en un correo electrónico el 16 de octubre que Guevara no es fundador de la organización. Reuters no encontró reportes creíbles que vinculen al periodista con la creación del grupo. Guevara fue detenido el 14 de junio de 2025 mientras cubría una marcha en Georgia y deportado a El Salvador el 3 de octubre, según publicaciones en su cuenta de Facebook y reportes de organizaciones internacionales . Veredicto: Falta contexto. Guevara no fundó la organización “Latinos por Trump” y fue deportado en octubre de 2025. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Vídeo mostra Círio de Nazaré em Belém, não ato de Flávio em MG
item.description: Um vídeo de uma multidão em uma avenida não mostra um evento de campanha do candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) em Minas Gerais, mas a procissão do Círio de Nazaré em Belém.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo de uma multidão em uma avenida não mostra um evento de campanha do candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) em Minas Gerais, mas a procissão do Círio de Nazaré em Belém. Estes são os principais detalhes: "Histórico o bloco do 22 hoje em Minas! A direita começou a ir pra rua no 2º turno", diz a legenda de uma postagem com as imagens no Facebook , compartilhada em 15 de outubro. O mesmo vídeo aparece em publicações no X no último dia 11, sendo atribuído à trasladação do Círio de Nazaré em Belém. Trata-se de uma procissão em homenagem a Nossa Senhora de Nazaré, na qual a imagem da santa ruma à Catedral Metropolitana de Belém. Neste ano, a romaria ocorreu em 10 de outubro . Nas imagens, aparecem a Companhia Docas do Pará e o Boulevard Castilhos França , em Belém, que fazem parte do trajeto da trasladação (página 24). As imagens são semelhantes a outros registros da trasladação deste ano, como esta transmissão ao vivo publicada pela Cultura Rede de Comunicação e pela Rede Nazaré de Comunicação no YouTube, além de imagens de drone compartilhadas no perfil do Círio de Nazaré no Instagram. No dia 15, Flávio estava em Minas Gerais, em comício em Capelinha , no Vale do Jequitinhonha. Veredicto: Legenda errada. As imagens não são de um comício de Flávio em Minas Gerais, mas de uma procissão do Círio de Nazaré em Belém. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: Trump says he is open to joining trilateral meeting with Xi, Putin
item.description: US President Donald Trump said on Monday he is open to participating in a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin and that it could be focused on denuclearization.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Monday he is open to participating in a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin and that it could be focused on denuclearization. "We would have it to talk about nuclear weapons and denuclearization," Trump told reporters outside the White House. "If President Xi wants to have it, I'd have it." Earlier Monday, the Kremlin said that Putin, Trump and Xi could hold a three-way meeting on the sidelines of next month's APEC summit in China and that a potential meeting had come up in talks.

item.title: Famosa caverna da Sibéria revela restos mortais de mamífero da Era Glacial
item.description: Uma caverna na Sibéria, já famosa por ter revelado os primeiros vestígios de uma linhagem humana extinta chamada denisovanos -- que outrora percorriam amplamente a Eurásia --, apresentou agora evidências de um grande mamífero da Era Glacial até então desconhecido, intimamente relacionado ao iaque atual.
item.dc:creator: Will Dunham
item.content:encoded: Uma caverna na Sibéria, já famosa por ter revelado os primeiros vestígios de uma linhagem humana extinta chamada denisovanos -- que outrora percorriam amplamente a Eurásia --, apresentou agora evidências de um grande mamífero da Era Glacial até então desconhecido, intimamente relacionado ao iaque atual. Os pesquisadores afirmaram ter descoberto pequenos fragmentos ósseos do animal na Caverna de Denisova, nas Montanhas Altai, no sul da Sibéria, na Rússia, e obtiveram DNA indicando que esses restos pertenciam a uma espécie bovina distinta de outras já conhecidas, tanto vivas quanto extintas. Ao todo, os pesquisadores estudaram 20 fragmentos ósseos dessa espécie -- 14 da Caverna de Denisova e 6 de outros sítios na região. O espécime mais antigo data de cerca de 250 mil a 200 mil anos atrás, e o mais recente, de cerca de 27 mil anos atrás. Os ossos em si estavam tão fragmentados que sua forma, por si só, não revelava que pertenciam a um grande mamífero até então desconhecido. Mas os pesquisadores conseguiram gerar 20 genomas antigos a partir dos ossos, e estes mostraram que se tratava de uma espécie única, cuja linhagem evolutiva divergiu dos ancestrais do iaque atual há aproximadamente 400 mil anos. “É incomum, especialmente reconhecer uma espécie de mamífero de grande porte a partir de fragmentos pequenos e não identificáveis”, disse o geneticista evolutivo Love Dalén, do Centro de Paleogenética -- uma colaboração entre a Universidade de Estocolmo e o Museu Sueco de História Natural --, autor sênior da pesquisa publicada na revista Current Biology. “Eu diria que isso está relacionado aos avanços no campo do DNA antigo, já que a genética é uma nova e poderosa fonte de informação aplicada a materiais antigos”, disse Alexandre Gilardet, doutorando do Centro de Paleogenética e coautor principal do estudo, juntamente com Jonas Oppenheimer, pesquisador de pós-doutorado do Centro de Paleogenética. Evidências genéticas por si só não são suficientes para permitir a atribuição de um nome científico a uma nova espécie; por isso, os pesquisadores estão chamando essa espécie de “Yak X”. A PAISAGEM DA ERA GLACIAL Dalén disse que o Yak X vivia ao lado de outros bovídeos, incluindo o bisão das estepes e o auroque, ancestral selvagem extinto do gado domesticado atual. Ele também compartilhava a paisagem da Era Glacial com mamutes-lanosos, rinocerontes-lanosos, cavalos e grandes predadores, como hienas-das-cavernas e ursos-pardos, disse Dalén. “Eu esperaria que ele se parecesse mais com um iaque do que com um bisão, dada sua estreita relação com os iaques modernos”, disse Dalén. Os iaques são animais de constituição robusta, com chifres, pelagem longa e uma corcova nos ombros, levemente parecidos com um boi peludo. Os machos maiores podem chegar a pesar até uma tonelada. Os iaques selvagens vivem exclusivamente nas altitudes mais elevadas do Planalto Tibetano. A descoberta do Yak X aprofunda a compreensão da diversidade dos grandes mamíferos da Era Glacial e acrescenta mais uma espécie à longa lista daquelas que desapareceram aproximadamente no fim dessa época. “Com base no longo período de 200 mil anos de nossa amostragem, podemos observar que a espécie pode ter sofrido um declínio populacional durante um período de aquecimento há cerca de 120 mil anos e se extinguiu algum tempo depois de nossa amostra mais recente, há cerca de 27 mil anos”, disse Oppenheimer. A vasta extensão siberiana era um ecossistema de pastagem chamado de estepe dos mamutes, assim conhecido por causa de seus maiores habitantes. A maior parte da região ficou livre das imensas camadas de gelo que cobriam grandes áreas da América do Norte e da Europa. A linhagem do Yak X divergiu dos ancestrais dos iaques modernos mais ou menos na mesma época em que ocorreu a separação evolutiva entre as linhagens ursinas que deram origem aos atuais ursos-pardos e ursos-polares. OS DENISOVANOS Foi na Caverna de Denisova, em 2008, que cientistas desenterraram um osso de dedo que ofereceu a primeira evidência da existência dos denisovanos, primos extintos dos neandertais e de nossa própria espécie, o Homo sapiens. Desde então, mais restos mortais de denisovanos foram descobertos na caverna e em várias regiões remotas da Ásia. Algumas populações humanas modernas, especialmente as da Melanésia e da Papua-Nova Guiné, carregam uma pequena porcentagem de DNA dos denisovanos, indicando cruzamento com o Homo sapiens antes que os denisovanos se extinguissem em circunstâncias que ainda não são bem compreendidas. Os denisovanos eram caçadores-coletores que sobreviveram em muitos tipos diferentes de ambientes. A espécie Yak X pode ter estado entre as presas que eles caçavam. “Parece razoável que o Yak X fizesse parte do cardápio dos denisovanos”, disse Dalén.

item.title: Petróleo Brent registra leve queda mesmo após ataques houthis à infraestrutura saudita
item.description: Os preços do petróleo apresentaram variações nesta segunda-feira, após ataques dos houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, a um campo de treinamento militar iemenita e novos ataques a instalações energéticas, aeroportuárias e militares da Arábia Saudita.
item.dc:creator: Siddharth Cavale
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo apresentaram variações nesta segunda-feira, após ataques dos houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, a um campo de treinamento militar iemenita e novos ataques a instalações energéticas, aeroportuárias e militares da Arábia Saudita. Os futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam com queda de 0,3%, a US$109,55 o barril, após terem caído mais de US$3 no início do pregão, quando os investidores realizaram lucros após a alta da semana passada, que levou os preços à maior cotação em cinco meses. O West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos subiu US$2,25, ou 2,2%, para US$103,66 por barril, o maior fechamento desde 15 de setembro. No entanto, o volume de negociações desse índice de referência foi relativamente baixo antes do vencimento, em 20 de outubro, do contrato do mês mais próximo. A atividade de negociação concentrou-se no contrato de dezembro, mais líquido, com mais de 195.000 lotes negociados, em comparação com cerca de 26.000 lotes no contrato de novembro, que está vencendo. O contrato de dezembro fechou a US$98,54, com queda de 0,5%. Os houthis do Iêmen afirmaram nesta segunda-feira ter realizado ataques contra alvos energéticos, aeroportuários e militares da Arábia Saudita, incluindo uma instalação da Aramco em Yanbu, o campo petrolífero de Shaybah, o Aeroporto Internacional Rei Khalid, em Riade, e o aeroporto de Abha. As autoridades sauditas não confirmaram imediatamente as alegações, e a Reuters não conseguiu verificá-las de forma independente. Separadamente, um petroleiro pegou fogo e explodiu após colidir com uma mina naval no sul do Estreito de Ormuz no domingo, informou a Guarda Revolucionária do Irã, segundo a mídia iraniana. O fluxo de petróleo pela região caiu para uma média de sete dias de cerca de 8,5 milhões de barris por dia na semana passada, ante mais de 20 milhões de bpd na semana anterior, informou a empresa de análise Kpler, devido ao aumento das ameaças à navegação comercial. A Kpler registrou pelo menos 10 incidentes confirmados envolvendo embarcações comerciais durante a semana. O analista da SEB, Bjarne Schieldrop, previu que os aumentos nos volumes de exportação pelo Estreito de Ormuz podem ser de curta duração, já que o Irã poderia intensificar os ataques antes das eleições intermediárias dos Estados Unidos, marcadas para 3 de novembro. O Egito afirmou estar pronto para apoiar a Arábia Saudita contra os houthis, embora o Parlamento egípcio tenha adiado para 26 de outubro uma votação que autorizaria as forças armadas a prestar assistência ao reino, caso solicitado. Na manhã desta segunda-feira, 53 pessoas foram mortas em um ataque houthi e 200 ficaram feridas em um ataque a um campo de treinamento das forças de segurança do governo iemenita na província produtora de energia de Shabwa, na região costeira do centro-sul do Iêmen.

item.title: Anthropic, Nscale in talks for new $45 billion AI cloud computing deal, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: Nvidia-backed Nscale is in talks to sell computing power to Claude maker Anthropic in a new deal that could be worth about $45 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the negotiations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nvidia-backed Nscale is in talks to sell computing power to Claude maker Anthropic in a new deal that could be worth about $45 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the negotiations. The data center developer is seeking another major deal with the AI lab for a second facility at its Monarch data center campus in West Virginia, according to the report. In August, Anthropic struck [USN:L4N44N1FK TEXT:"a deal to spend $45 billion"] to rent AI cloud computing power from Nscale's West Virginia data center campus. A second Monarch building would deliver 460 megawatts of computing power using Nvidia's (NVDA.O) advanced Vera Rubin AI chips, the report said. Nscale and Anthropic did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Reuters could not independently verify the report. Anthropic also has the right of first refusal on Monarch's expected third building, the report said, adding discussions are ongoing and details of the plan could change. Bloomberg News also reported that a cohort of investors had urged Anthropic to lower its [USN:L4N45A1JP TEXT:"IPO valuation"] target after a series of market setbacks for AI companies. Investors have sharpened scrutiny of companies that are increasingly turning to debt-driven AI infrastructure expansion. Last week, Nscale rival CoreWeave's (CRWV.O) [USN:L4N46111C TEXT:"shares slumped amid"] concerns over its $50 billion debt load, fueling a global AI stock rout. The news of a potential tie-up comes after Microsoft (MSFT.O) [USN:L5N3V30O9 TEXT:"pulled out of a deal"] to anchor a flagship data center for Nscale after power connection delays pushed its expected supply date into the 2030s. Nscale has grown rapidly since launch, increasing its total contracted value from $100 million to more than $103 billion in two-and-a-half years and competing with Nebius (NBIS.O) , Crusoe and Lambda. According to the Nscale prospectus, Microsoft and Anthropic are expected to be the company's major customers in the future.

item.title: Actividad económica de Colombia se contrae en agosto por primera vez en 16 meses
item.description: La actividad económica de Colombia decreció un 0,04% interanual en agosto, su primera contracción desde abril del año pasado, debido a una caída en la minería, el agro, la industria y la construcción, informó el lunes el Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La actividad económica de Colombia decreció un 0,04% interanual en agosto, su primera contracción desde abril del año pasado, debido a una caída en la minería, el agro, la industria y la construcción, informó el lunes el Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE). La variación del Indicador de Seguimiento a la Economía (ISE) en el octavo mes contrastó con la expansión de 1,06% interanual de julio y de 2,71% interanual de agosto del año pasado. En términos mensuales, la actividad económica colombiana decreció un 3,11% con respecto a julio. Las actividades primarias, que incluyen las agropecuarias y la explotación de minas y canteras, decrecieron un 3,19% interanual en agosto, mientras que las secundarias, que abarcan la industria manufacturera y la construcción, cayeron un 3,03% interanual, reveló el DANE en un comunicado. En contraste, las actividades terciarias, que agrupan la administración pública, los servicios financieros y de seguros, el suministro de electricidad, gas, vapor, aire acondicionado, y distribución de agua, se expandieron un 1,10% interanual en agosto. En el acumulado entre enero y agosto, la actividad de la cuarta economía de América Latina creció un 2,27%, inferior al 2,62% registrado en el mismo periodo del año previo. El equipo técnico del Banco de la República y el Ministerio de Hacienda proyectan que la economía colombiana crecerá 2,5% en 2026, cifra marginalmente inferior al pronóstico inicial de 2,6%.

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ下落、仏財政懸念で ドルはＡＩ株反発で上昇
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。フランスでの暴動が同...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ下落、仏財政懸念で　ドルはＡＩ株反発で上昇 4:35 配信

2026年10月19日、フランス・パリで撮影。REUTERS/Abdul Saboor

［ニューヨーク　１９日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ユーロが対ドルで下落した。フランスでの暴動が同国の財政見通し悪化への懸念を一段と強めた。一方、ドルは人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の反発を受けて上昇した。

フランスでは、政府が財政赤字の縮小を図る中、政府に対する全国的な抗議デモが週末に暴動と略奪に発展。これを受け、フランス当局は１９日、首都パリや北部リール、南部ニースなど複数の都市の一部地域に夜間外出禁止令を発令した。

今回の暴動は、極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の実質的な指導者マリーヌ・ルペン氏が来年の大統領選で勝利する可能性を高めるとも見られており、フランスのＥＵ残留を巡って疑問が浮上する恐れがある。

ユーロは０．２４％安の１．１２１２ドル。独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４７ｂｐに拡大し、２０１１─１２年の欧州債務危機以来の水準で取引された。

主要通貨バスケットに対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．１７％高の１０１．９７。

ドルは、ＡＩ関連株が先週の急落から反発したことを受けて上昇した。先週は、ＡＩ株に対する熱狂の後退が資本流入を細らせ、ドル需要を減退させるとの懸念からドルが押し下げられていた。

カナダドルは対米ドルで０．２７％高の１米ドル＝１．４１カナダドル。カナダ銀行（中銀）のマックレム総裁が１７日に示したタカ派的な発言が通貨を下支えした。

産油州であるアルバータ州では１９日、同州がカナダから分離独立すべきかどうかを問う住民投票が実施される。

円は対ドルで０．３５％下落し、１ドル＝１５８．４９円。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 158.48/158.52

始値 158.20

高値 158.54

安値 158.11

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1210/1.1214

始値 1.1217

高値 1.1231

安値 1.1203

item.title: Pakistan army chief Asim Munir to visit Tehran on Tuesday
item.description: Pakistan's army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir is due to visit Tehran on Tuesday, according to a Pakistani official and Iranian media.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pakistan's army chief Field Marshal Asim Munir is due to visit Tehran on Tuesday, according to a Pakistani official and Iranian media. Pakistan has played a key mediating role between the U.S. and Iran this year. The scheduled visit follows earlier talks between Munir and Iranian leaders in the summer that focused on measures to prevent further escalation, reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and an expedited termination of the conflict.

item.title: CON O ¿Qué es la traición a la patria en México y por qué se acusa a un exfiscal?
item.description: El exfiscal de Chihuahua, César Jáuregui, fue detenido el fin de semana en México por su presunta responsabilidad en delitos que podrían constituir "traición a la patria" en materia de seguridad nacional, tras un operativo en abril en el que fallecieron dos agentes estadounidenses en un accidente carretero tras una operación para desmantelar un narcolaboratorio.
item.dc:creator: Diego Oré
item.content:encoded: El exfiscal de Chihuahua, César Jáuregui, fue detenido el fin de semana en México por su presunta responsabilidad en delitos que podrían constituir "traición a la patria" en materia de seguridad nacional, tras un operativo en abril en el que fallecieron dos agentes estadounidenses en un accidente carretero tras una operación para desmantelar un narcolaboratorio. La fiscal general, Ernestina Godoy, dijo que Jáuregui, quien fue fiscal de Chihuahua entre 2023 y 2026, habría permitido que agentes extranjeros intervinieran en facultades exclusivas de la Federación y habría ocultado información que estaba obligado a compartir. El delito por el que se le acusa es uno de los más graves contra el Estado y nadie ha sido condenado por él desde mediados del siglo XIX. A continuación, tres preguntas sobre el delito de traición a la patria en México: ¿QUÉ ES LA TRAICIÓN A LA PATRIA? La legislación mexicana no ofrece una definición única de traición a la patria, pero la configura como actos contra la independencia, soberanía o integridad del país en favor de un gobierno, Estado o grupo extranjero. Los artículos 123 a 126 del Código Penal Federal incluyen conductas como colaborar con fuerzas extranjeras, facilitar una invasión, entregar información estratégica o promover una intervención extranjera, con penas de hasta 40 años de prisión. A diferencia de otros delitos, castiga conductas que podrían comprometer la seguridad nacional o someter al país a la influencia o control de una potencia extranjera, por lo que su aplicación ha sido históricamente muy poco frecuente. La última condena histórica ampliamente reconocida por ese delito fue la de Maximiliano de Habsburgo, emperador de México entre 1864 y 1867. Maximiliano fue condenado y fusilado en 1867 después de que el gobierno republicano de Benito Juárez determinara que el imperio que encabezó, apoyado por tropas francesas, vulneraba la independencia y soberanía de México. ¿QUÉ CONDUCTAS PUEDEN CONSTITUIR TRAICIÓN A LA PATRIA? Entre las conductas que pueden constituir traición a la patria figuran participar en hostilidades contra México bajo las órdenes de un Estado extranjero, proporcionar información estratégica que pueda afectar la seguridad nacional, facilitar una invasión, colaborar con fuerzas o grupos armados dirigidos por extranjeros o reclutar personas para combatir contra el país. El Código Penal Federal también considera traición a la patria acciones como privar ilegalmente de la libertad a una persona en territorio mexicano para entregarla a autoridades de otro país o trasladarla al extranjero con ese fin. Hay una gran diferencia entre ser acusado de traición a la patria y ser condenado por ella. Las acusaciones recientes no han concluido aún en sentencias firmes. En 2024, la fiscalía general mexicana abrió una investigación y buscó judicializar cargos por "traición a la patria" contra Joaquín Guzmán López, hijo del capo narco Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán, por el traslado de [USN:L6N43M0W5 TEXT:"Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada"] a Estados Unidos. ¿QUIÉNES PUEDEN SER ACUSADOS? Las disposiciones sobre traición a la patria se aplican principalmente a ciudadanos mexicanos, aunque el Código Penal Federal también prevé sanciones para extranjeros que participen en las conductas contempladas por la ley. La figura tiene además rango constitucional. El artículo 108 de la Constitución mexicana establece que incluso el Presidente puede ser imputado durante su mandato por traición a la patria, reflejando la gravedad excepcional que el ordenamiento mexicano atribuye a este delito. El lunes, Jáurequi, del partido opositor PAN, fue trasladado a una cárcel de máxima seguridad en el Estado de México, contiguo a la capital. El jueves, un juez determinará sin es vinculado a proceso y si los delitos que se le imputan ameritan prisión preventiva. "La acusación de traición a la patria contra el exfiscal de Chihuahua César Jáuregui busca sentar un precedente y prevenir que la cooperación entre gobiernos estatales y el gobierno de Estados Unidos se dé sin la coordinación y visto bueno de la Federación", opinó Matías Gómez Léautaud, analista de Eurasia. "Hay una dimensión política clara, dado el gobierno de oposición de Chihuahua. Las elecciones intermedias de 2027 engendran incentivos para la presidencia de evidenciar fracasos por gobiernos estatales de oposición y la presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum tiene una confrontación con la gobernadora Maru Campos, lo cual aumenta la importancia del caso para la agenda nacional", agregó.

item.title: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield (thumb) closing in on return
item.description: Quarterback Baker Mayfield, who has been sidelined since dislocating his right thumb during the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' Week 3 loss to the Minnesota Vikings, is getting closer to a return.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Quarterback Baker Mayfield, who has been sidelined since dislocating his right thumb during the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' Week 3 loss to the Minnesota Vikings, is getting closer to a return. Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles told reporters Monday that Mayfield is expected to practice this week for the first time since the injury occurred. "He's supposed to practice Wednesday," Bowles said. "We're gonna take a good look at him there, and we'll kind of evaluate him during the week and see how he does." In Mayfield's absence, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels has started the last three games, going 1-2. Including his Week 3 appearance off the bench, Daniels has completed 61.2% of his passes for 501 yards, three touchdowns and five interceptions. While the starter is expected back at practice, it remains unclear if Mayfield will be available to play against the Carolina Panthers on Sunday, with Bowles admitting the team will prepare for both QB options. "I think you have to (prepare multiple game plans)," Bowles said. "Both will be in the meetings, obviously. Both will be in the meetings and we'll see how the week goes before we decide who it is." Tampa Bay (1-5) was lagging behind in the NFC South even before Mayfield's injury. But the Buccaneers are only 2 1/2 games behind the division-leading Panthers (3-2), with the chance to make up a full game in the standings with a victory Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Balanza comercial de Argentina anota superávit de 2.976 mln dlr en septiembre: INDEC
item.description: El Intercambio Comercial Argentino (ICA) contabilizó un saldo positivo de 2.976 millones de dólares en septiembre, dijo el lunes el Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos (INDEC), un dato muy por encima de lo esperado en el mercado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Intercambio Comercial Argentino (ICA) contabilizó un saldo positivo de 2.976 millones de dólares en septiembre, dijo el lunes el Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos (INDEC), un dato muy por encima de lo esperado en el mercado. Analistas consultados por [USN:L1N4610J9 TEXT:"Reuters"] proyectaban un superávit de 1.800 millones de dólares para el noveno mes del 2026. Según datos del INDEC, las exportaciones subieron un 23,5% a 10.036 millones de dólares y las importaciones retrocedieron el 1,8% a 7.060 millones de dólares. El ICA argentino supera así, por primera vez en la historia, el umbral mensual de superávit por 10.000 millones de dólares, con el aval de cuatro grandes rubros. "Las exportaciones de 'Combustibles y Energía' se incrementaron 89,1%, en tanto las 'Manufacturas de Origen Industrial', las 'Manufacturas de Origen Agropecuario' y las de 'Productos Primarios' aumentaron 17,5%, 16,8% y 9,2%, respectivamente", resaltó el ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo, en su cuenta de X. "Las exportaciones de 'Combustibles y Energía' fueron las más altas de la historia para un mes, en tanto las de 'Manufacturas de Origen Industrial' fueron las mayores desde noviembre de 2012", agregó. La balanza comercial del país sudamericano viene anotando saldos mensuales positivos consecutivos desde la asunción del presidente libertario, Javier Milei, en diciembre de 2023. - Para más información ver página

item.title: Âmbar Energia, da J&F, reforma usina no Amazonas para operar com gás e solar
item.description: A Âmbar Energia, controlada pela holding J&F, investiu R$59 milhões para reconfigurar uma usina termelétrica no Amazonas para operar com duas fontes, gás natural e energia solar, anunciou a companhia nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Âmbar Energia, controlada pela holding J&F, investiu R$59 milhões para reconfigurar uma usina termelétrica no Amazonas para operar com duas fontes, gás natural e energia solar, anunciou a companhia nesta segunda-feira. A unidade localizada em Codajás, de 5,4 megawatts (MW) de capacidade, está sendo integrada a uma planta fotovoltaica com capacidade de 9,7 megawatts-pico (MWp), em projeto cuja conclusão está prevista para dezembro, disse a Âmbar. A ideia da usina "híbrida" é que os painéis solares assumam parte da geração durante o dia, reduzindo a necessidade de queima de gás, que será utilizado principalmente para geração à noite. Segundo a empresa de energia dos irmãos Batista, o projeto é o primeiro do Amazonas a operar com energia solar e gás para atendimento dos chamados "sistemas isolados", comunidades que não recebem energia elétrica do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN) e dependem majoritariamente de geração termelétrica local. "Codajás depende exclusivamente da energia gerada na própria cidade. Com o sol e o gás trabalhando juntos, a usina ganha uma camada extra de segurança. Isso é decisivo em um lugar onde qualquer insumo leva horas de barco para chegar", afirmou Fábio Tales Bindemann, diretor de operações da Âmbar Energia, em nota. Pelos cálculos da empresa, a geração solar poderá evitar a emissão de cerca de 10 mil toneladas de CO₂ por ano. A usina Codajás também deve servir de laboratório para projetos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento (P&D) da Âmbar, que está estudando iniciativas como o uso de inteligência artificial para automatizar o equilíbrio entre gás e solar ao longo do dia.

item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Famous Siberian cave yields remains of yak-like Ice Age mammal

A yak grazes on a grass patch some 3,000 metres (9,842 feet) above sea level in the mountains outside Almaty November 1, 2009. REUTERS/Shamil Zhumatov/File Photo

FAST

Oct 19 : A Siberian cave already famous for yielding the first remains of an extinct human lineage called the Denisovans, who once roamed widely in Eurasia, has now produced evidence of a previously unknown large Ice Age mammal closely related to today's yak. Researchers said they discovered small bone fragments of the animal in Denisova Cave in the Altai Mountains of southern Siberia in Russia, and obtained DNA that showed these remains belonged to a bovine species distinct from others already known, living and extinct. In all, the researchers studied 20 bone fragments from this species — 14 from Denisova Cave and 6 from other sites in the broader region. The oldest specimen dated to about 250,000 to 200,000 years ago, and the youngest to about 27,000 years ago. The bones themselves were so fragmentary that their shape alone did not reveal that they belonged to a previously unknown large mammal. But the researchers were able to generate 20 ancient genomes from the bones, and these showed that this was a unique species whose evolutionary lineage diverged from the ancestors of the modern-day yak approximately 400,000 years ago.

"It is unusual, especially to recognize a large mammal species from small, unidentifiable fragments," said evolutionary geneticist Love Dalén of the Centre for Palaeogenetics, a collaboration between Stockholm University and the Swedish Museum of Natural History, senior author of the research published in the journal Current Biology. "I'd say that this is related to the advances in the field of ancient DNA, as genetics is a powerful new layer of information applied to ancient materials," said Alexandre Gilardet, a doctoral student at the Centre for Palaeogenetics and co-lead author of the study, along with Centre for Palaeogenetics postdoctoral researcher Jonas Oppenheimer. Genetic evidence alone is not sufficient to allow for giving a scientific name to a new species, so the researchers are calling this one "Yak X." THE ICE AGE LANDSCAPE Dalén said Yak X lived alongside other bovines including steppe bison and the aurochs, the extinct wild ancestor of today's domesticated cattle. It also shared the Ice Age landscape with woolly mammoths, woolly rhinoceroses, horses and large predators such as cave hyenas and brown bears, Dalén said. "I'd expect it to have looked more like a yak than a bison, given its close relationship to modern yaks," Dalén said. Yaks are sturdily built animals with horns, long fur and a hump at the shoulders, looking a bit like a hairy ox. The largest males can weigh as much as a ton. Wild yaks are restricted to higher elevations of the Tibetan Plateau. The Yak X discovery deepens the understanding of the diversity of large Ice Age mammals and adds another species to the long list that disappeared at around the end of that epoch. "Using the long, 200,000-year time span of our sampling, we can see that the species may have undergone a population decline during a period of warming around 120,000 years ago, and went extinct some time after our youngest sample, about 27,000 years ago," Oppenheimer said. The vast Siberian expanse was a grassland ecosystem called the mammoth steppe, known as such for its largest denizens. Most of the region was left uncovered by the immense ice sheets that had blanketed large swathes of North America and Europe. The Yak X lineage diverged from the ancestors of modern yaks around the same time as the evolutionary split that occurred between the ursine lineages that led to today's brown bears and polar bears. THE DENISOVANS It was in Denisova Cave in 2008 that scientists unearthed a finger bone that offered the first evidence of the existence of Denisovans, extinct cousins of Neanderthals and our own species, Homo sapiens. Since then, more remains of Denisovans have been discovered in the cave and in several far-flung parts of Asia. Some modern populations of people, especially those in Melanesia and Papua New Guinea, carry a small percentage of DNA from Denisovans, indicating interbreeding with Homo sapiens before the Denisovans became extinct under circumstances that are not well understood. Denisovans were hunter-gatherers who survived in many different types of environments. The Yak X species might have been among the prey that they hunted. "It seems reasonable that Yak X was on the Denisovan menu," Dalén said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（19日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
反落して取引を終えた。銀行や鉱業株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は４営業日ぶりに反落した。中型株で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（19日） 3:50 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。銀行や鉱業株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は４営業日ぶりに反落した。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．６３％安と、７営業日ぶりの反落。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は２．３３％安。銀行大手のバークレイズは３．５％下落。プライベートクレジット融資に関する流動性などのリスクを過小評価するような不適切な表示をした疑いでイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が調査していると伝わった。

鉱業株指数は２．６５％安。銅価格の値下がりを受けて、資源大手アングロ・アメリカンは４．１％、グレンコアは３．３％、それぞれ下落した。

航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．３７％、公益事業株指数は２．１３％、それぞれ値下がりした。通期生産見通しを引き下げた石油・ガス会社セリカ・エナジーは２．０％下落した。

ヒーリー英財務相による初の予算案公表を来週に控える中、今週は消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）や小売売上高といった英経済指標が発表される。多くの企業決算も開示される予定となっている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

４営業日ぶりに反落して取引を終えた。２０２７年に大統領選を控えるフランスで、物価高や公共サービスの悪化に抗議するデモが拡大し、政局が混迷しつつある。財政を巡る懸念も相場の重荷となり、フランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は１．１１％下落した。このほか、総選挙を１１月に控えて政治的な不透明感が強まったスペインのＩＢＥＸ指数も１．４９％安だった。

フランスの金融機関ＢＮＰパリバ、クレディ・アグリコル、ソシエテ・ジェネラルは２．５─３．４％下落。フランスの小売大手カルフールは２．２％、ショッピングセンターなどを手がけるウニベイル・ロダムコ・ウエストフィールドは２．１％それぞれ値下がりした。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は２．０７％下落。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．４３％安。

一方、テクノロジー株指数は０．７０％上昇。

今週は、ドイツのソフトウエア大手ＳＡＰ、フィンランドの通信機器大手ノキア、英銀大手のバークレイズの決算発表が予定されている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

フランス国債利回りが上昇した。週末にフランス全土で抗議活動が繰り広げられたことを受け、巨額の財政赤字削減が同国政府にとっていかに困難かが浮き彫りとなった。

フランスでは１７日、生活費の高騰と公共サービスの質の低下に抗議するデモが一部で暴徒化し、同国で過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展。商業・小売連盟によると、週末に被害を受けた店舗は約３０００店に上っている。

投資家は、フランスが財政を立て直すには予算案を可決する必要があると指摘しているが、今回の抗議デモはそれがいかに難しいかを示している。来年の大統領選を控えた政治的な駆け引きが、事態をさらに複雑にする可能性もある。

ＳＭＢＣのグローバル市場ストラテジスト、ハンク・カレンティ氏は、財政赤字削減や年金改革の取り組みに言及し「抗議デモが繰り広げられた週末を経てこうした動きになったことは、改革への期待が後退していることを示している」と述べた。

フランス１０年債利回りは１３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９％と、１日としては９月下旬以来の上昇幅となる見通しとなった。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは４ｂｐ上昇の３．４５％。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４６ｂｐと、２週間ぶりの高水準となった。それでも、１０月序盤に付けた１６０ｂｐ近辺からは縮小している。

イタリア１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ上昇の４．５８％。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

item.title: フーシ派、サウジのアラムコ施設や空港攻撃と主張 軍事施設も標的
item.description: [１９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１９日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は１９日、サウジアラビアのエネルギー関連施設や空港、軍事施設を標的とした複数の攻撃を実施したと表明した。サウジ西部の紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーにある国有石油企業サウジアラムコの施設、シャイバ油田、首都リヤドのキング・ハーリド国際空港、アブハ空港を攻撃したとしている。

サウジ側からの確認は直ちには得られておらず、ロイターもこの主張を即座に検証できていない。

item.title: Palestinian activist Mahmoud Khalil asks US Supreme Court to hear case seeking to avoid re-arrest
item.description: Columbia University graduate Mahmoud Khalil on Monday asked the US Supreme Court to overturn a ruling that opened the door for President Donald Trump's administration to re-arrest and deport the Palestinian activist.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond, Jonathan Allen
item.content:encoded: Columbia University graduate [USN:L1N3SG0OI TEXT:"Mahmoud Khalil"] on Monday asked the US Supreme Court to overturn a ruling that opened the door for President Donald Trump's administration to re-arrest and deport the Palestinian activist. Khalil's lawyers asked the justices to take up his case after the Philadelphia-based 3rd US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that federal immigration law barred a lower-court judge from ordering his release from US Immigration and Customs Enforcement custody. Khalil was among the most prominent foreign students to be arrested last year as the Trump administration pursued a campaign to detain and deport noncitizens who engaged in pro-Palestinian activism on college campuses. His lawyers say the Supreme Court should make clear immigration law does not prevent noncitizens from pursuing cases arguing they have been detained to punish them for speech that is protected by the US Constitution's First Amendment. "If the Trump administration can punish someone for their pro-Palestine speech, this or any future administration can punish anyone for any speech," Khalil told reporters on Monday. If the 3rd Circuit's decision is allowed to stand, Khalil faces the prospect of arrest and deportation, after the Board of Immigration Appeals in April rejected his challenge to an immigration judge's order that he be removed to Algeria or Syria. A lower court order barring him from being re-detained remains in place for now until the Supreme Court rules. A separate appeal of the immigration judge's order remains pending. A spokesperson for the US Department of Homeland Security, which oversees ICE, in a statement said the Trump administration acted within its authority in Khalil's case, and it encouraged him to self-deport. KHALIL'S BACKGROUND AND ARREST Khalil, a prominent figure in pro-Palestinian protests against Israel's war in Gaza , is an Algerian citizen who was born in a Palestinian refugee camp in Syria. Immigration agents arrested him in March 2025 in the lobby of his university residence in Manhattan despite his being a lawful permanent resident, or green-card holder. His wife and their 1-year-old son are both US citizens. Secretary of State Marco Rubio had invoked an obscure provision of the Immigration and Nationality Act to deem Khalil removable, citing his involvement in "antisemitic protests and disruptive activities" at Columbia in 2024 that the government said fostered a hostile environment for Jewish students. He was released from a Louisiana detention center in June 2025 after the New Jersey-based US District Judge Michael Farbiarz, an appointee of former President Joe Biden, ordered the Department of Homeland Security to release him. In January, a 2-1 panel of the 3rd Circuit overturned Farbiarz's decision, saying that under the Immigration and Nationality Act, Khalil's claims could not be addressed through a district court and instead could be raised in an appeal of a removal order from an immigration judge. After the full appeals court declined to reconsider the case, Khalil turned to the Supreme Court. Federal appeals courts are split on whether district judges may hear challenges like Khalil's or whether such claims must proceed first through immigration courts, which are not part of the federal judiciary but are instead run by the US Department of Justice. The Trump administration [USN:L1N45E0AE TEXT:"last month asked"] the Supreme Court to overturn a ruling in a similar case favoring Georgetown University scholar Badar Khan Suri, another pro-Palestinian advocate detained by ICE who was ordered released.

Oct 19 : Brentford said on Monday they were working with police to identify those responsible after a rugby ball appeared to be kicked from a nearby rooftop towards their Gtech Community Stadium during Saturday's Premier League defeat by Liverpool. A viral video on social media showed a man kicking the ball from a nearby rooftop towards the stadium, where it appeared to bounce off the roof, while a separate clip showed staff carrying it away. "Brentford Football Club is aware of an incident involving an item being kicked from a height towards the field of play during Saturday's match against Liverpool," the club said in a statement. "Such behaviour is dangerous and potentially very harmful.

Brentford lost the game 2-1 after surrendering a first-half lead and finishing with nine men. The Gtech Community Stadium is surrounded by residential and commercial buildings. Brentford are sixth in the league standings with 10 points from seven matches and visit Hull City on Sunday.

item.title: トランプ氏、女性の健康に関する大統領令署名 ＮＩＨに新部門創設へ
item.description: [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１９日、メラニア夫人とともに、女性の健康に焦点を当てたホワイトハウスのタスクフォース（作業部会）と国立衛生研究所（ＮＩＨ）の部門を創設する大統領令に署名した。

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスでのイベントで、タスクフォースはスージー・ワイルズ大統領首席補佐官と、ケネディ厚生長官が主導すると表明。タスクフォースは１９日に初会合を開くと明らかにした。

トランプ氏は「大統領令は、保健福祉省（ＨＨＳ）に対し、ＮＩＨ内に新たな女性の健康部門を設立するよう指示するものだ」と述べた。

ホワイトハウスのファクトシートによると、同大統領令は連邦政府に対し、女性の人生のあらゆる段階にわたって包括的に健康問題に取り組むよう指示するもので、予防、診断、治療を加速させるための研究を強化し、研究成果を臨床実践や政策に反映させることを目指す。

ＮＩＨに新設される「女性の健康部門」は、同機関の「女性の健康研究室」に取って代わるものではなく、連携して機能する。

ホワイトハウスは、今回の措置は政府の取り組みを研究の枠を超えて広げ、研究成果を女性や少女のための臨床ケアへと応用することを優先するためのものだと説明した。

item.title: 米メタ、「反トランプ」デモ主催者のインスタ一時停止巡り陳謝
item.description: [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは、全米各地で１７日に開催されたトランプ米政権に対する抗議活動「ＮＯ　ＫＩＮＧＳ（王はいらない）」の主催者や参加者が利用していたインスタグラムのアカウントが活動中に一時停止されていたと明らかにした。メタの担当者は「心からおわびする」と陳謝した。

アカウント停止の理由について、利用が短期間に集中した際、通常の閲覧ではなく、特定の作業を自動処理する「ボット」によるものと似たアクセスが増えたためだと説明している。

１７日には数千の集会が開かれ、参加者はトランプ大統領による強硬な移民政策やイラン攻撃などを非難し、１１月３日の米中間選挙の期日前投票を呼びかけた。その際、参加者らのインスタグラムのアカウントが１時間超、利用できなくなった。

メタの広報担当アンディ・ストーン氏は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）Ｘへの投稿で、復旧作業に時間がかかったと説明。セキュリティーシステムで、投稿やハッシュタグを読み取る人工知能（ＡＩ）ツール「クロード」の使用急増が検知され、「自動保護機能が誤ってアカウントを停止した」と説明した。

集会主催者は１９日、ＳＮＳブルースカイで「インスタグラムの停止だけでなく、抗議活動や期日前投票に関する内容がメタのプラットフォーム全体でアクセスができなくなったり、制限されたりしたとの報告を受けている」と指摘。「選挙を数週間後に控え、謝罪だけでは不十分だ。説明責任を果たすことや具体的な対策が必要だ」と訴えた。

FAST

MUMBAI, Oct 19 : Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance said on Monday that Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, BlackRock and Fidelity were among investors who bid in the anchor book of its record $3.2 billion Jio Platforms IPO, which two sources said drew more than $25 billion in demand. The telecoms, cloud and AI group on Monday opened its record initial public offering to institutional investors who can bid for up to 30 per cent of the offering exclusively earmarked for them, before the issue opens for public subscription on Wednesday.  Jio Platforms allocated shares worth over 81 billion rupees ($853.31 million) to anchor investors, a company filing showed on Monday. State-run insurer Life Insurance Corporation, French lender BNP Paribas, JPMorgan, India's largest private-sector lender HDFC Bank were among the other institutions allotted shares in the IPO anchor book.

The bids drawn were over 30 times the quota reserved for anchor investors, a source told Reuters. Jio upended India's telecoms market in 2016 by offering free voice calls and cheap data and soon became the country's biggest mobile operator. It now has more than 500 million subscribers and competes with Bharti Airtel and Vodafone Idea. Its listing is seen as a test of what global investors will pay for that scale and for Jio's expansion into cloud and AI. Led by Mukesh Ambani's son Akash Ambani, Jio operates Reliance Industries' telecom and digital businesses, spanning mobile services, fixed broadband, cloud, entertainment, enterprise technology and AI offerings. Jio's IPO follows September's listing of the National Stock Exchange of India, underscoring investor appetite for large offerings in the Indian market. It will be the first offering by Reliance since its listing of Reliance Petroleum in 2006. Year-to-date Indian IPO proceeds rose 8.3 per cent to $12.65 billion compared with the same period last year, LSEG data shows. A successful IPO would place Jio Platforms among the top four Indian listed companies by market capitalisation, behind its parent Reliance, its rival Bharti Airtel and the country's largest private lender HDFC Bank. Jio plans to use up to 275 billion Indian rupees ($2.90 billion) of the net proceeds to repay or prepay borrowings of its telecom subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm. ($1 = 94.9475 Indian rupees)

item.title: 米ロッキードと「パトリオット」供給加速巡り協議＝ゼレンスキー氏
item.description: [１９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１９日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１９日、ロシアの弾道ミサイル迎撃に不可欠な地対空ミサイルシステム「パトリオット」の供給を加速させる方法について、米防衛大手ロッキード・マーチンの代表者と協議したと明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー氏は「ロシアの弾道ミサイルやジェットエンジン式ドローン（無人機）に対する防衛で、ロッキード・マーチンが製造するパトリオット・システムのほか、Ｆ１６戦闘機が重要な役割を果たしている」と通信アプリ「テレグラム」に投稿。「現在、いずれの面でも容易な状況ではない。供給をどのように拡大し、増強できるか協議した」とした。

ロシアはこの日の未明にかけて、ウクライナ全土に対する広範な攻撃を実施。ゼレンスキー氏は、同盟国から事前の警告を受けていなかったと明らかにしている。

NEW YORK, Oct 19 : A joint Lake Placid-New York City Olympic bid for 2042 moved one step closer to reality on Monday, as members of an exploratory committee met for the first time in Manhattan with the five boroughs aiming for their first-ever Winter Games. An enviable array of arenas bolsters the five boroughs' latest campaign for the Games while Lake Placid boasts Olympic pedigree after hosting in 1932 and 1980. But even 16 years out, committee members are working to identify any potential obstacles that could stand in their way, after the IOC overhauled bidding rules this year under new President Kirsty Coventry. "Transportation particularly will be one of the biggest challenges. The Milano Cortina model has shown though that they were able to work through those. They didn't have high-speed rail connecting the two, but they were able to successfully deliver the games despite that," Olympic Regional Development Authority Chair Ashley Walden told Reuters.

"So it's something that certainly will be looked at and particularly I think is going to be identified as a legacy item because it is a need for the long term." The 2026 Milano Cortina Games have been held up as an example of a successful dispersed Olympics, with events spread out across northern Italy. No high-speed rail connects New York City with Lake Placid, a picturesque Adirondack ski town that would become the first city to host three times if the bid is successful. Housing in New York state's "North Country" also presents a potential challenge. The 1980 Olympic village was later turned into a medium-security prison. "This is going to be a generational opportunity," New York Governor Kathy Hochul told committee members. "The planning now, the talk, the buzz, the excitement, the people saying, well, we're probably going to need some more hotels and restaurants and housing. And I'm going to be focused on this to just inject new energy into the North Country." Committee members include Laura Pegula, whose family own the NFL's Buffalo Bills, and New York State Assembly member Robert Carroll. Some are still feeling the sting from New York City's unsuccessful bid for the 2012 Summer Games, when a failed attempt at building a West Side Stadium undermined an otherwise compelling campaign. The 2012 Olympics eventually went to London. The most recent World Cup has eased some of those bitter memories, with the final held at New Jersey's MetLife Stadium and the New York New Jersey Committee welcoming millions of tourists to the region, largely without issue. If they are successful, Lake Placid-New York City would be the third American host for the Games in 14 years, after LA28 and Salt Lake City in 2034. Two-time Olympic Super-G medallist Andrew Weibrecht, the Games Operations Subcommittee co-chair, told Reuters it could help spark a new generation of American winter sports talent. "When you take the traditional venue (in Lake Placid) and pair it with a large city, I think that's a great recipe for games," Weibrecht told Reuters.

Source: Reuters

LISBON, Oct 19 : Cristiano Ronaldo was suspended for 30 days by the Portuguese FA on Monday after leaving the national team camp following a rift with coach Jorge Jesus over his role in the side. The federation's disciplinary council said it had upheld the charge against the 41-year-old forward in full and imposed a fine of 255 euros ($285.83). Ronaldo left Portugal's base in Copenhagen before their Nations League match against Denmark earlier this month, having accused Jesus of twice breaking his word about his role after he was an unused substitute against Norway. Jesus denied making any agreement with Ronaldo but left the door open for his return following Portugal's 2-1 win.

Proceedings were opened on October 9 over facts reported two days earlier. Ronaldo later apologised for failing to acknowledge supporters after the Norway match and for leaving his teammates, saying he remained available for selection after serving any punishment arising from the incident. item.title: Private equity firm Charlesbank bets on US law firm in back office deal
item.description: Private equity firm Charlesbank Capital Partners has invested in the back-office operations of US insurance defense firm Wood Smith Henning & Berman, the law firm said on Monday, marking the latest influx of outside capital into the traditional legal market.
item.dc:creator: Sara Merken
item.content:encoded: Private equity firm Charlesbank Capital Partners has invested in the back-office operations of US insurance defense firm Wood Smith Henning & Berman, the law firm said on Monday, marking the latest influx of outside capital into the traditional legal market. Wood Smith Henning & Berman, a Los Angeles-based trial firm with more than 550 lawyers across 23 states, said it created a management services organization called WSHB Support Services that will provide non-legal operational infrastructure and support to the firm. Capital from middle-market private equity firm Charlesbank into that unit will help the law firm expand geographically and invest in technology, artificial intelligence and data science capabilities, the firm said. Terms of the deal were not disclosed. the Financial Times previously reported that the transaction values the law firm at about $700 million. Charlesbank and Wood Smith Henning & Berman did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the valuation. The transaction is one of the most notable examples of investment in the legal industry through a management services organization (MSO), highlighting investors’ [USN:L6N3X712M TEXT:"growing interest"] in the sector. Lawyers, consultants and other businesses are increasingly [USN:L6N43U157 TEXT:"marketing their expertise"] in advising on such deals. Investors and others who are not lawyers are broadly prohibited from owning direct stakes in US law firms or sharing in attorney fees. The MSO model provides a vehicle for law firms to receive outside investments without breaching those professional rules. Outside investors can own or take stakes in the law firm's non-legal, back-office operations through the MSO, which is paid through the firm's revenues without any direct sharing of fees. Wood Smith Henning & Berman in a statement said it will remain an independent law firm with its lawyers “retaining sole authority over the practice of law and client matters." The firm said it represents insurers, self-insured corporations and institutional clients. Charlesbank in a statement said it had deep investment experience in the professional services and insurance fields that it would bring to its partnership with the law firm. The deal follows a growing number of publicly disclosed law firm MSO transactions this year, some involving [USN:L6N46019U TEXT:""AI-native""] law firms. Massumi + Consoli, a private equity and M&A-focused law firm, last month announced the launch of a new MSO. Another private equity firm, Darien, Connecticut-based Uplift Investors has [USN:L6N45G11Y TEXT:"inked deals"] with six personal injury firms so far this year. Law firms Gipson Hoffman & Pancione and Troutman Pepper Locke advised Wood Smith Henning & Berman on the deal with Charlesbank, the firm said. Weil, Gotshal & Manges, Kirkland & Ellis and Frankfurt Kurnit Klein & Selz advised Charlesbank.

item.title: El papa León insta a Zelenski a cooperar con Rusia en la ayuda a Oleshki
item.description: El papa León mantuvo el lunes una conversación telefónica con el presidente ucraniano Volodímir Zelenski, informó el Vaticano, e instó a Ucrania y a Rusia a cooperar para permitir la entrada de ayuda y alimentos en la localidad bloqueada de Oleshki.
item.dc:creator: Joshua McElwee
item.content:encoded: El papa León mantuvo el lunes una conversación telefónica con el presidente ucraniano Volodímir Zelenski, informó el Vaticano, e instó a Ucrania y a Rusia a cooperar para permitir la entrada de ayuda y alimentos en la localidad bloqueada de Oleshki. Los habitantes de esta localidad ucraniana, ocupada por las fuerzas rusas desde febrero de 2022, han denunciado que la crisis alimentaria se está agravando. La conversación la tuvieron tres días después de que León pidió al presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, que organice un alto el fuego para que la ayuda pudiera llegar a Oleshki, una petición sobre la que el Kremlin no se pronunció cuando dijo que Putin ayudaría a organizar los suministros. León "expresó su esperanza de que la cooperación entre ambas partes permita el envío de alimentos y ayuda médica, así como la evacuación voluntaria y segura de la población civil", dijo el Vaticano en un comunicado sobre la llamada del lunes. Zelenski, en comentarios publicados en Telegram, contó que él y el papa habían hablado sobre la situación en Oleshki, y añadió: "Estamos trabajando para ayudar a nuestra gente allí. Estamos preparando una solución". El papa, según él, le expuso sus conversaciones con Rusia sobre la situación. Zelenski también señaló que las conversaciones se centraron en "los retos y amenazas en materia de seguridad" y en tres casos recientes en los que Ucrania no recibió ningún aviso previo de sus socios sobre inminentes ataques con misiles rusos. El papa, que se está recuperando de una operación de cáncer de pulmón, habló el viernes con Putin y le pidió que organizara un alto el fuego para facilitar la entrada de ayuda humanitaria en Oleshki. El Kremlin dijo posteriormente que Putin había accedido a cooperar con el papa para organizar el envío de suministros a la localidad, pero no mencionó ningún alto el fuego. León, que asumió el papado en mayo de 2025, se ha reunido con Zelenski en varias ocasiones. La última vez que se vieron fue en diciembre, en la residencia papal en Castel Gandolfo, en Italia, tras lo cual Leo instó a los líderes europeos a adoptar un enfoque colectivo en las negociaciones de paz entre Rusia y Ucrania. Durante la noche, Rusia lanzó uno de sus ataques aéreos más intensos contra Ucrania en meses, disparando 16 misiles balísticos contra Kiev y la región circundante, así como más de 200 drones por todo el país.

item.title: Pope Leo urges Zelenskiy to cooperate with Russia on aid for Oleshky
item.description: Pope Leo held a phone call on Monday with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, the Vatican said, and urged Ukraine and Russia to cooperate to let aid and food into the blockaded town of Oleshky.
item.dc:creator: Joshua McElwee
item.content:encoded: Pope Leo held a phone call on Monday with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, the Vatican said, and urged Ukraine and Russia to cooperate to let aid and food into the blockaded town of Oleshky. Residents of the Ukrainian town, occupied by Russian forces since February 2022, have reported [USN:L8N45K1N1 TEXT:"a deepening food crisis"]. The call came three days after Leo asked Russian President Vladimir Putin to arrange a ceasefire so aid could enter Oleshky, a request the Kremlin did not address when it said Putin would help organise supplies. Leo "expressed the hope that cooperation between both parties will allow for the delivery of food and medical aid, and for the voluntary and safe evacuation of the civilian population," the Vatican said in a statement about Monday's call. Zelenskiy, in comments posted on Telegram, said he and the Pope discussed the situation in Oleshky, adding: "We are working on helping our people there. We are preparing a solution." The pope, he said, outlined his talks with Russia on the situation. Zelenskiy also said discussions focused on "security challenges and threats" and three recent instances in which Ukraine received no advance warning from its partners of impending Russian missile attacks. The pope, who is [USN:L8N4650IM TEXT:"recovering"] from lung cancer surgery, spoke on Friday with Putin and [USN:L8N4621IK TEXT:"asked him"] to arrange a ceasefire to facilitate the entry of aid into Oleshky. The Kremlin said afterwards that Putin had agreed to cooperate with the pope to organise supplies for the town, but did not mention a ceasefire. Leo, who became pope in May 2025, has met with Zelenskiy several times. They last saw each other in December, at the pope's residence in Castel Gandolfo in Italy, after which Leo urged European leaders to [USN:L8N3XF0JS TEXT:"take a collective approach"] in negotiating peace between Russia and Ukraine. Russia overnight launched one of its broadest air assaults against Ukraine [USN:L1N46500P TEXT:"in months"], firing 16 ballistic missiles at Kyiv and the surrounding region and more than 200 drones across the country.

Oct 19 : Tournament host Tiger Woods was not listed in the initial player field released on Monday for the December 3 to 6 Hero World Challenge in Albany, Bahamas, but could still be added as one of the three exemption spots. The 15-times major champion has not competed in an official event since the 2024 British Open due to a combination of injuries, surgeries and legal complications. Woods accepted a five-year suspension of his driver's license last month after reaching a deal with prosecutors in his impaired-driving case. World number one Scottie Scheffler and defending champion Hideki Matsuyama are among the 17 players who have officially committed to the Hero World Challenge's 20-man field. Scheffler, who won back-to-back titles in 2023 and 2024, and Matsuyama are both looking to become the first three-time winner at Albany. In total, seven of the top 10 players in the world are among those in the field, a group that in addition to Scheffler includes Cameron Young, Matt Fitzpatrick, Russell Henley, Chris Gotterup, Sam Burns and Xander Schauffele. The rest of the field will be announced at a later date.

Source: Reuters

FAST

MILAN/MADRID, Oct 19 : The Euroleague remains open to talks with the NBA over a potential tie-up in Europe, with CEO Chus Bueno warning that competing leagues would fragment the continent's basketball market. The continent's premier club basketball competition rejected an NBA collaboration proposal at an owners' meeting held at Italy's Lake Como on October 6.  With the NBA pressing ahead with plans to launch a new European league in 2027, the prospect of two rival competitions emerging is increasingly coming into focus. Bueno warned of the dangers of further fragmenting the market. "If they decide to (enter into the market), it's going to be a disaster. And they know, we know, and we don't want that," Bueno told Reuters on Monday.

"We had some conversations after Como. And the position of the owners was very clear. We will always be open to listen, and to talk with the NBA about any potential deal. But it has to make sense for us," said Bueno. "The telephone lines are open and, if something has not worked, maybe there's something that can work in the future," he added, declining to elaborate on the terms of the NBA Europe proposal. EXPANSION STRATEGY The Euroleague currently consists of 13 permanent shareholder clubs but plans to approve up to eight long-term franchise licences as it expands to a 24-club competition. Bueno said the league will announce the new teams joining the competition in mid-November as part of a multi-year growth strategy unveiled last week. Under the expansion plan, which includes a shift to a franchise-based model, the collective value of the Euroleague's licensed clubs is projected to triple to €5.4 billion ($6.06 billion) from an estimated €1.8 billion. The league itself is expected to rise in value to €7.98 billion from €1.4 billion, or 5.7 times its current estimated value, over the next decade. Of the current Euroleague licence holders, only 40 per cent are sustainable, but Bueno said that would change going forward. "I think that in five years with this expansion, we could be in a position where most, if not all, of them will be (financially) sustainable," he said.  EUROLEAGUE UNITY Bueno also said he viewed the prospect of Euroleague clubs leaving to join NBA Europe as unlikely, arguing that the risks involved would be too great for the teams concerned. "I don't believe this is going to happen. I think that the teams want to be together and act together. And this is what I'm hearing and what we heard in Lake Como from all of them. "If you are divided, you lose value, and then some third party benefits. One of the things that we don't want is more fragmentation," said Bueno, adding that "it will be bad for basketball." The 13 shareholder clubs have all signed 10-year franchise agreements tied to the strategic expansion plan. "If they want to leave, they have a penalty they can pay, and then the clubs can also ask for individual damages. They will lose the €80 million-plus that they have in shares. "But if they ever want to come back, they will have to pay whatever number it is when they ask to come back," said Bueno, adding: "So I think that they have a lot to lose if they do (leave)." ($1 = 0.8912 euros)

Source: Reuters

GQEBERHA, South Africa, Oct 19 : Australia paceman Scott Boland continued to torment South Africa's batsmen with two more wickets on Monday to leave the hosts on 97 runs for five wickets at stumps on the second day of the second test at St George's Park. Boland finished the rain-affected day with figures of 4-31 to put Australia in a strong position with South Africa to resume on Tuesday with captain Temba Bavuma 41 not out and Wiaan Mulder unbeaten with two runs. Play got underway at 3:45 p.m. local time (1345 GMT) with 30.4 overs bowled after heavy rain in the morning threatened to wash out Monday's play. Boland, who took two wickets in the one hour of play possible on Sunday, added a third in the third over of the second day's play, inducing an edge from debutant opener Marques Ackerman, who was dismissed for six.

Matthew Breetzke, brought into the home line-up after the 214-run defeat in the first test in Durban last week, then departed for four runs after he was also caught behind by wicketkeeper Alex Carey, playing away from his body to Mitchell Starc's left-arm delivery. South Africa were in a precarious position at 40-4 but Bavuma led a fightback with Ryan Rickelton as they put on 52 runs for the fifth wicket. Rickelton was dropped on 26 by leg slip Marnus Labuschagne off captain Pat Cummins in what looked a regulation chance, but he only added five more runs before a brilliant one-handed catch by Matt Renshaw at first slip gave Boland a fourth wicket. Bavuma provided some home hope with a resolute innings in spite of the relentless pressure from the Australian attack, which had to do without Josh Hazlewood, who took a career-best 6-49 in the first test but was absent with an upset stomach. No more rain is forecast for the rest of the test as Australia look to wrap up the three-match series. Extra time is to be added to all three sessions on Tuesday.

NEW YORK, Oct 19 : IT services company DXC Technology is in advanced talks to sell its insurance software and services division to private investment firm Eldridge Industries for about $2.4 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. Eldridge is discussing combining the business with Zinnia, its insurance technology platform that provides software and digital infrastructure to life insurance and annuity providers, the sources said. An agreement could be reached in the coming weeks, although there is no certainty a deal will be finalized, the people said, requesting anonymity because the discussions are confidential. DXC Technology, Eldridge and Zinnia did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

The transaction would mark a significant divestiture for DXC as the information technology services provider seeks to streamline its portfolio after several years of declining revenue.  The sale would allow DXC to exit a business that provides technology and outsourcing services to insurers globally, helping the IT services provider streamline its operations after several years of declining revenue. Its insurance division offers policy administration systems and other software and business process services to insurers across life, wealth, property and casualty markets.  For Eldridge, a transaction would combine Zinnia's life and annuity technology platform with DXC Technology's insurance software and business-process services operations, creating a scaled provider of software, administration and servicing technology for insurers.

item.title: イスラエル、ガザへの商業物資搬入再開へ 税巡る対立解消
item.description: [カイロ １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カイロ １９日 ロイター] - イスラエルは１９日、パレスチナ自治区ガザへの商業物資の搬入を再開すると発表した。援助に依存するガザへの食料など生活必需品の重要な供給ルートが復活する。物資搬入は、パレスチナのイスラム組織ハマスと商人の間の課税を巡る対立で数日間停止していた。

ガザでの人道問題を管轄するイスラエル軍機関「ＣＯＧＡＴ」は、ハマス当局がトラック１台当たり１万シェケル（３２２５ドル）の支払い要求を取り下げたと商人側が報告したことを受け、再開を決定したと説明した。

ＣＯＧＡＴは「調整の再開は、停戦合意の人道的条項を順守するというイスラエルの約束に沿って実施される」と表明した。商人側の説明は独自には確認できていないとした上で、搬入は段階的に再開し、冬を前に生活必需品が優先されるとした。

支払いが銀行振込を通じてのみ行われ、記録に残る形で授受されるよう監視を強化する。ハマスに支払いを行ったことが判明した商人はシステムから排除されるという。

ハマスは、１万シェケルの費用は戦禍で荒廃した地域で困窮者を支援する「基金」への裕福なガザ住民による任意の拠出だと説明している。

FAST

LONDON, Oct 19 : S&P Global estimates the world's biggest tech firms are likely to have more AI-linked liabilities than currently known, although its top analyst for the sector sees no need to change any ratings at present. Debt issued by AI infrastructure providers and so-called 'neocloud' firms such as Nvidia-backed CoreWeave has sunk to increasingly stressed levels in recent weeks amid concerns about the aggressive scale of their borrowing. S&P's Global Head for Digital Infrastructure Mark Habib said the biggest risk to hyperscalers' ratings remained whether expected profits fail to materialise. But he also highlighted so-called 'interconnected financing structures', where hyperscalers effectively guarantee huge data centre builds, or smaller AI companies.

"It is safe to assume that there is more (debt) out there that we are not seeing," Habib said during a roundtable in London. "If it's not reported, then it's not part of the disclosure by the hyperscalers. Also, if we are not rating the transactions where this liability may accrue, then the fact of the matter is that we might not have the visibility." S&P expects the top six US hyperscalers — Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, Oracle, Meta, and SpaceX — to spend more than $7 trillion on data centers and other AI-related capex between 2025 and 2030, and have negative free cash flow until at least next year. Habib said there wasn't an estimate of how much additional debt the circular financing might add to firms' balance sheets, although he said S&P was trying to take a "holistic" view overall. Back in July, it downgraded Oracle to BBB-, the lowest rung of 'investment grade', on concerns about its AI spending and what it called "an uncertain path to profitability". Habib was also asked whether the recent market selloff of bonds linked to the aggressive AI buildout was a sign that investors see them as riskier than ratings indicate. "For now, we don't have the view that there is a major disconnect that needs to force our ratings to change at this point," he said, saying S&P's scores were designed to take a longer-term view. He said what could change that view was if it became clear the amount of money being spent was no longer sustainable. "And that could come from a variety of drivers," Habib said. "Further increases in the investments (by AI firms), or a view that the revenue rate of competition is getting too intense."

Source: Reuters
