item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Unilever (ULVR.L) said on Monday it has agreed to sell Welly Health PBC to private-equity firm Forward Consumer Partners, but did not disclose financial terms of the sale. The consumer products giant had acquired a majority stake in the US brand, known for its colorful adhesive bandages, in 2021 from Welly co-founder Eric Ryan for an undisclosed price. The deal, first reported by the Wall Street Journal, is expected to close in the fourth quarter, subject to customary closing conditions Separately, Forward Consumer Partners announced that Ryan will return to the business as a strategic advisor and a member of the board Unilever, the maker of Knorr stock cubes and Hellmann's mayonnaise, has been shifting towards beauty and well-being brands under CEO Fernando Fernandez Forward said the acquisition of Welly would mark its first investment in the consumer health sector

item.title: Brazil detects Newcastle disease at turkey farm, raising export concerns
item.description: Brazil has detected a case of Newcastle disease at a turkey farm in the southern state of Santa Catarina, Agriculture Minister Andre de Paula said on Monday, raising concerns about potential disruptions to poultry shipments from the world's largest chicken meat exporter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil has detected a case of Newcastle disease at a turkey farm in the southern state of Santa Catarina, Agriculture Minister Andre de Paula said on Monday, raising concerns about potential disruptions to poultry shipments from the world's largest chicken meat exporter. China, one of Brazil's largest markets for chicken meat, halted imports from Rio Grande do Sul after a Newcastle disease case was confirmed at a commercial farm in the state in 2024. The ban was [USN:L1N3YL0U4 TEXT:"lifted earlier this year"]. Newcastle is a highly contagious and viral disease affecting birds, like avian flu Brazilian officials said sanitary measures have been put in place and are expected to affect 133 farms in the region, adding all relevant information will be shared with the country's main trading partners Brazil's Acting Secretary for Agricultural Trade, Rafael Requiao, said it was too early to provide any concrete information on possible import suspensions Meat lobby group ABPA told Reuters that Brazil's trade protocol with China provides for the suspension of poultry exports following a Newcastle disease outbreak The protocol, ABPA said, triggers an "auto-embargo" before Chinese authorities decide whether restrictions should apply to the entire state or to a limited area around the affected farm Analysts at Citi said that Santa Catarina accounts for around 15% of Brazilian poultry production, making the scope of potential restrictions particularly relevant

item.title: Brasil registra foco de Doença de Newcastle em perus em Santa Catarina
item.description: O Ministério da Agricultura registrou um foco de Doença de Newcastle em uma criação de perus em Santa Catarina, disse nesta segunda-feira o ministro da Agricultura, André de Paula, levantando preocupações sobre potenciais interrupções nas exportações de carne frango do maior exportador global do produto.
item.dc:creator: Victor Borges, Roberto Samora
item.content:encoded: O Ministério da Agricultura registrou um foco de Doença de Newcastle em uma criação de perus em Santa Catarina, disse nesta segunda-feira o ministro da Agricultura, André de Paula, levantando preocupações sobre potenciais interrupções nas exportações de carne frango do maior exportador global do produto. A China, um dos principais destinos das exportações brasileiras de carne de frango, impôs em 2024 um embargo ao produto do Rio Grande do Sul após a confirmação de um caso de Doença de Newcastle em uma granja comercial no Estado. Essa situação só foi revertida no início deste ano. Outros países também chegaram a banir provisoriamente o produto brasileiro naquela oportunidade. Nesta segunda-feira, autoridades disseram que o ministério está informando parceiros comerciais sobre o caso da doença viral altamente contagiosa para aves, que não causa problemas para a saúde humana. Autoridades acrescentaram que o ministério ainda não recebeu qualquer informação sobre suspensão das exportações brasileiras por conta do foco em perus, em um estabelecimento de avicultura comercial de corte no município de Nova Itaberaba (SC). "Ainda não temos nada objetivo a informar (sobre suspensão de exportações)", afirmou o secretário-substituto de Comércio e Relações Internacionais do ministério, Rafael Requião. Ele disse ainda que o Brasil está analisando os protocolos para identificar quais medidas serão tomadas para um eventual "autoembargo" de exportações. "Não queremos antecipar a reação de parceiros, as discussões com a China começam agora", disse Requião. Um acordo assinado com a China prevê que as exportações de carnes de aves brasileiras sejam [USN:L1N4650TK TEXT:"suspensas"] no caso da ocorrência de Doença de Newcastle, como a confirmada em uma granja de perus em Santa Catarina no domingo, disse o presidente da Associação Brasileira de Proteína Animal (ABPA), Ricardo Santin, à Reuters. A China aparece como o maior mercado importador de carne de frango do Brasil neste ano --os chineses responderam por cerca de 10% das vendas totais do Brasil de janeiro a setembro, importando 420 mil toneladas, segundo dados do governo brasileiro. A partir do "autoembargo", a China costuma definir como fica o embargo, se restrito apenas à região ou ao Estado atingido pelo foco da doença, explicou Santin. Requião, do Ministério da Agricultura, disse ainda que o governo tem trabalhado com protocolos sanitários que permitem a "regionalização" do problema, o que evitaria embargos mais abrangentes sobre a carne brasileira. As medidas de controle, contenção e erradicação do foco serão executadas conforme as diretrizes do Plano de Contingência para Influenza Aviária e Doença de Newcastle, disse o ministério. O estabelecimento Nova Itaberaba foi interditado pelo Serviço Veterinário Oficial, com suspensão da movimentação de aves. Já o secretário de Defesa Agropecuária substituto, Allan Alvarenga, afirmou que a doença não representa riscos à população. Ele acrescentou que a Organização Mundial de Saúde Animal foi notificada do caso no domingo. Apesar da necessidade de adoção de "medidas sanitárias para controlar a ocorrência, o consumo de produtos avícolas submetidos à inspeção oficial permanece seguro, sem contraindicações", ressaltou o ministério, em nota. Associações de produtores, como ABPA, ACAV e Sindicarne, destacaram em nota que a ocorrência de Doença de Newcastle não apresentou "manifestação clínica". Ou seja, houve a detecção do vírus, mas não da doença nos animais confinados.

item.title: Eagles quarterback Hurts set to miss rest of season due to blood clots
item.description: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has blood clots in both lungs, the team and his agent said on Monday, and media reports said the former Super Bowl MVP was expected to miss the rest of the 2026 season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has blood clots in both lungs, the team and his agent said on Monday, and media reports said the former Super Bowl MVP was expected to miss the rest of the 2026 season. Hurts is clinically stable and his treatment should only involve blood thinners, which will rule him out of contact activities, the Eagles and agent Nicole Lynn said in a statement. The 28-year-old was initially diagnosed with a left calf superficial vein thrombosis after an ultrasound in London before Philadelphia's 19-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, which Hurts played in. The current diagnosis is a deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli. A bilateral pulmonary embolism is where a blood clot travels from a deep vein in the body, often the leg, and blocks an artery in both lungs. "Jalen's prognosis is very good, and we expect a full recovery. We anticipate that he will have the opportunity to resume contact football activities when off the blood thinners," the statement said, adding no long-term effects are expected. According to an ESPN report, Hurts was in the hospital in London until 4 a.m. on the day of the game and did not sleep the night before the contest as a health precaution. Speaking at a press conference on Monday, Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said that the team care deeply about their players and that he trusts the team's medical staff. "I'm a football coach. I lean on our medical experts in every situation. I have full trust and full faith in them," Sirianni said. "We get medical information from our guys, and we always put the players' health first and foremost in every situation. And, you know, that's where we were there." The Eagles said in a statement on Thursday that their medical staff and doctors in London reviewed the ultrasound results and concluded that "activity and mobility were important" and that Hurts could safely play in the game against the Jaguars, adding that he "played without limitation". Hurts guided the Eagles to the Super Bowl title in February 2025, throwing for two touchdowns and running in another against the Kansas City Chiefs to earn the game's Most Valuable Player trophy.

item.title: Canadian firms' outlooks dimmed after trade talks collapse, BoC survey finds
item.description: By Promit Mukherjee and David Ljunggren
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: By Promit Mukherjee and David Ljunggren OTTAWA, Oct 19 (Reuters) - Canadian firms reported their outlooks had deteriorated after the collapse of trade talks with the United States but sentiments remained considerably stronger than at the peak of tensions last year, the Bank of Canada said on Monday. A survey of around 340 business leaders in September showed that since the talks broke down on August 21, new US tariffs and Canadian counter tariffs had weighed on their outlooks. The bank said this suggested "a moderation rather than a fundamental shift in firms' outlooks". A separate Business Outlook Survey for the third quarter, which was largely carried out before the talks collapsed, showed overall sentiment had improved. But both surveys pointed to higher inflation expectations amid increase input costs and elevated selling prices due to trade tensions and the Middle East crisis. The studies help the BoC decide the trajectory of inflation and feed into its decision for the monetary policy. Money markets are pricing in a hold in interest rates by the BoC on October 28, but see a 25 basis point rise in December. Governor Tiff Macklem says while headline inflation has risen, this is primarily due by higher energy costs and there are so far no signs of a spillover into other components. But he also says he is ready to hike rates if higher prices show signs of feeding into the broader economy. The leaders' survey reported weaker export sales, the BoC said, adding that the improving sentiment at the beginning of the third quarter had partially reversed. "Nevertheless, sentiment and expectations remain considerably stronger than at the height of trade tensions in 2025," it added. In the Business Outlook Survey, the central bank said while there were some improvements in demand, firms' hiring intentions remained soft, but most firms intend to retain existing employees. Expectations for wage growth are largely unchanged, the survey noted. The business outlook indicator, a metric of prospects under current economic conditions, edged up to -0.33 in the third quarter from -0.38 in the prior three months. A separate survey by the central bank on consumer expectations showed that more than 50% of consumers surveyed expect a recession over the next 12 months and expectations for five-year inflation had also risen. ((Reuters Ottawa bureau)) Keywords: CANADA CENBANK/

item.title: Retailer Ahold Delhaize reports cybersecurity incident to Dutch police
item.description: AMSTERDAM, Oct 19 : Retailer Ahold Delhaize reported a cybersecurity incident to Dutch police on Monday after it detected suspicious activity in its infrastructure, the company said, adding it took some systems offline as a precaution earlier this month.Although only reported to the police on Monday, t
item.dc:creator: CNA

Retailer Ahold Delhaize reports cybersecurity incident to Dutch police

Ahold Delhaize logo is seen in this illustration taken, February 11, 2025. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Oct 19 : Retailer Ahold Delhaize reported a cybersecurity incident to Dutch police on Monday after it detected suspicious activity in its infrastructure, the company said, adding it took some systems offline as a precaution earlier this month. Although only reported to the police on Monday, the incident coincided with a cyberattack in France that caused refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of stores to heat up to 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit) overnight, sparking fires and spoiling food. The Dutch National Cyber Security Centre said there was no reason to believe the incident in the Netherlands was directly linked to any cyberattacks in other countries. Delhaize said its investigations found the suspicious activity had resulted from the "malicious actions of others", without specifying who might be responsible.

"Taking systems offline to help protect them was a precautionary measure that affected most of our brands across Europe and the United States. The investigation to date confirms this was the right decision", President and CEO Frans Muller said. NO ONLINE ORDERS BEFORE THURSDAY Earlier on Monday, Ahold Delhaize's Albert Heijn, the Netherlands' largest supermarket chain, said it would not resume online deliveries before Thursday at the earliest, extending to at least 11 days an outage caused by the cybersecurity incident. Online accounts for about 10 per cent of Albert Heijn sales. While Albert Heijn's website was back online on Monday, the websites of Ahold Delhaize’s US chains remained offline, a week after the cyber incident forced the company to shut down some of its IT systems. Ahold Delhaize said it expected e-commerce services at its US brands to resume "in the coming days". The US brands, which include Stop & Shop, Giant Food, Hannaford and Food Lion, collectively rank among the country’s largest food retailers. Deliveries at Belgian chain Delhaize resumed over the weekend. Ahold Delhaize previously said that there was no evidence that any customer data had been stolen. Physical stores of several chains have remained open, but have struggled with supplies as distribution channels were also affected.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Plaza cambiaria argentina se mantiene controlada con seguimiento de banco central
item.description: El mercado cambiario argentino cerró con mermas el lunes mediante el habitual control del banco central (BCRA) que regula la liquidez cotidiana, en momentos en que el riesgo país saltaba a su máximo nivel en casi un año.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El mercado cambiario argentino cerró con mermas el lunes mediante el habitual control del banco central (BCRA) que regula la liquidez cotidiana, en momentos en que el riesgo país saltaba a su máximo nivel en casi un año. La autoridad monetaria aumentó en las últimas jornadas su accionar intervencionista, donde el viernes adquirió 68 millones de dólares y acumuló un saldo semanal positivo levemente superior a los 640 millones de dólares. En este inicio de semana, sumó 18 millones a sus reservas. Las compras de la entidad elevaron las "reservas internacionales brutas a 50.236 millones de dólares y completando un saldo semanal comprador de 642 millones de dólares, el monto más alto registrado en los últimos tres meses", expresó Wise Capital. "La estrategia oficial responde a la urgencia de abastecer de divisas al Tesoro de cara a los compromisos de deuda con tenedores de bonos Globales agendados para el próximo 9 de enero", añadió. En este contexto, el peso mayorista se depreció un 0,43% a 1.524,5 unidades por dólar para la venta, con ligeras caídas en los precios de los contratos a futuro. Por su parte, el riesgo país argentino trepaba a los 678 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), su mayor nivel desde finales de octubre del año pasado, con los bonos en el segmento extrabursátil cayendo un firme 1,3% por la misma debilidad de los negocios. "La suba del riesgo país obedece a la incertidumbre global", aseguró el vocero presidencial Adrián Ravier en conferencia de prensa, con la certeza de que el país tiene instrumentos para afrontar presiones como más reservas e intercambio de monedas con otros países, que "en caso de ser necesarios, se pueden usar". La secretaría de Finanzas, dependiente del Ministerio de Economía, anunció una conversión de títulos que se llevará a cabo el martes. "La operación permitirá a los tenedores del bono 'dollar-linked' con vencimiento a fines de octubre (D30O6) canjearlo por instrumentos con vencimiento a fines de noviembre, en enero de 2027 y en junio de 2027", afirmó la consultora Max Capital. "Al igual que en anteriores vencimientos de instrumentos 'dollar-linked', el Tesoro ofrece un canje anticipado para reducir la potencial volatilidad cambiaria antes de la fijación del precio el 27 de octubre", añadió. El índice accionario líder de Argentina, localmente conocido como Merval, pasó a llamarse desde este lunes MSCI Merval tras el acuerdo entre Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos (BYMA) y el proveedor global de índices MSCI. "Como adelantamos al anunciar la alianza estratégica entre BYMA y MSCI (...) se lanzarán los nuevos índices de Renta Variable", dijo BYMA en un comunicado. Y agregó que entre algunas de las principales características con la que contarán los índices será un valor inicial de 100.000 pesos para ambos y una moneda de publicación que será en pesos argentinos y dólares estadounidenses. El flamante nuevo referencial MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) debutó con una caída del 1,84% al cierre dado el contexto desfavorable para los activos domésticos.

item.title: Monedas suben en medio de respiro en favor activos de más riesgo; Brasil espera balotaje
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, aunque en una jornada de cotizaciones en rangos estrechos, pese a un leve avance del dólar en los mercados globales y una cotización dispar de los precios del crudo, con los mercados de Brasil a la espera del balotaje presidencial.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, aunque en una jornada de cotizaciones en rangos estrechos, pese a un leve avance del dólar en los mercados globales y una cotización dispar de los precios del crudo, con los mercados de Brasil a la espera del balotaje presidencial. * Los precios del petróleo terminaron mixtos el lunes, con el contrato WTI de Estados Unidos anotando una fuerte alza y el referencial Brent una ligera baja, tras los ataques perpetrados por los hutíes contra un campo de entrenamiento militar yemení y sus nuevas incursiones contra instalaciones energéticas, aeroportuarias y militares saudíes. * Mientras, el índice dólar , que mide al billete verde frente a una canasta de seis monedas pares, sumó un ligero 0,17%, respaldado por un repunte de las acciones del sector de la inteligencia artificial en Wall Street. * Sólidos datos de crecimiento de China ayudaron también con el ánimo en favor del riesgo de los inversores. En el tercer trimestre, la expansión económica del gigante asiático trepó un 4,5%, rebotando desde mínimos de tres años y superando ligeramente las expectativas. * El peso mexicano subía por la tarde un 0,3%, a 18,4258 unidades por dólar, también a la espera de datos de inflación local durante la semana. El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, ganó un ligero 0,09%, a 68.994,24 puntos, en una semana marcada por el inicio de los resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre. * "A pesar de la apreciación del peso... no pueden descartarse presiones al alza para el tipo de cambio debido a que se han reanudado las presiones al alza sobre los instrumentos del Tesoro", dijo Banco Base en un reporte. * "El tipo de cambio suma cuatro sesiones consolidándose en un canal entre 18,40 y 18,60 pesos por dólar. Sin embargo, esto no implica un cambio de tendencia y dado que las presiones al alza persisten y son fuertes, lo más probable es que en las próximas jornadas el tipo de cambio se dirija nuevamente hacia el nivel clave de 18,50 pesos por dólar". "Persiste el riesgo de alcanzar de nuevo el máximo en el año de 18,6033 pesos por dólar", remarcó. * El real brasileño sumó un 0,5%, a 5,0476 unidades por dólar, al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) perdió preliminarmente un 0,15%, a 205.126 puntos, en una semana en que los mercados están atentos al balotaje presidencial del fin de semana. * Los últimos sondeos de opinión muestran una muy estrecha ventaja del senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro sobre el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, quien ha recortado la diferencia respecto de encuestas previas. * El peso chileno , terminó la jornada con un alza del 0,32%, en 980,90/981,10 unidades por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , retrocedía un 0,14%, a 10.955,42 puntos. * El peso colombiano cerró con alza de un 0,48% a 3.157,91 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSIC COLCAP (.COLCAP) , se desvalorizó un 1,74% a 2.521,69 puntos. * "Esta fortaleza del peso colombiano se ve influenciada por los altos precios en el petróleo, pero también por la alta tasa de interés de referencia del Banco de la República", escribió el Banco de Bogotá. * El peso mayorista argentino se depreció un 0,43% a 1.524,5 unidades por dólar para la venta, en medio del control de liquidez por parte del banco central (BCRA), que en la jornada sumó 18 millones de dólares a sus reservas. Mientras, el referencial de la bolsa de Buenos Aires, MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) , se hundió un 1,84%. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un leve 0,06% a 3,4360/3,4370 unidades por dólar, tras cotizar en rojo más temprano. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) perdió un 0,11%, a 1.576 puntos.

item.title: Four Salvadoran air force members missing after gang ambush in Haiti
item.description: Heavily armed criminal gangs ambushed members of an international security force in Haiti, and four Salvadoran troops were missing after fleeing their burning armored vehicle near Port-au-Prince, authorities told the UN Security Council on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Heavily armed criminal gangs ambushed members of an international security force in Haiti, and four Salvadoran troops were missing after fleeing their burning armored vehicle near Port-au-Prince, authorities told the UN Security Council on Monday. The UN-backed Gang Suppression Force is seeking to add soldiers as it fights gang violence, including massacres that have forced nearly 1.5 million people to flee their homes. In the ambush, gangs attacked the armored vehicle with explosives, setting it ablaze, and the four members of El Salvador's air force leaped out, the Salvadoran military said. At a UN Security Council meeting in New York about Haiti, US Ambassador Mike Waltz said the Salvadorans' vehicle was hit by "hundreds of bullets and explosives" in the ambush while returning to base from a market. Contact with the soldiers was lost, and Salvadoran helicopters that tried to reach the area came under fire, the Salvadoran military said. Igor Rugwiza, a spokesman for the force, told Reuters the mission was still searching for the four amid heavy fighting. "There have been multiple attempts to reach the area by land and air, but these have been hampered by the intensity of the fighting and the security conditions in the area," El Salvador's armed forces said in a statement. The international force advised people living near Santo village on the northeastern outskirts of Port-au-Prince, where the Chen Mechan and 400 Mawozo armed criminal groups hold sway, to stay indoors until further notice. Speaking to reporters in New York, Stephane Dujarric, spokesperson for the UN secretary general, condemned the attack and called for the soldiers' immediate and safe release. The Salvadoran team is among several international contingents that make up the security force, tasked with helping police restore security amid a bloody gang conflict that has killed more than 21,000 people in the last four years. Jack Christofides, the force's special representative, told the UN meeting that the contingent had reached 2,000 troops, just over a third of its target. Countries contributing personnel include Chad and Guatemala. The UN approved the force about a year ago and that triggered the withdrawal of a prior UN-backed force that had struggled to obtain troops, equipment and funding. "The force is making a difference with what it has," Christofides said. "We have stayed concentrated rather than dispersed." The missions have made little dent in the gangs' widespread control over Haiti's capital and surrounding areas. Earlier this month, Haiti's government said it was reviewing the schedule for its first election in a decade, which had been planned for December. Carlos Ruiz, who heads the UN Integrated Office in Haiti, told reporters he expected elections could happen next year if security allowed. Christofides said "hostile incidents" against the security force have increased over the last month. Gangs have also ramped up ransom kidnappings, even targeting high-profile figures including the defense minister's chief of staff.

item.title: 中国証監会、市場安定を最優先へ 株式や債券の動向注視＝国営メディア
item.description: [上海／北京 １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[上海／北京 １９日 ロイター] - 中国国営メディアは１９日、中国証券監督管理委員会（証監会）の呉清主席が北京で開かれた金融フォーラムで、資本市場の安定を最優先する方針を示したと報じた。株式や債券、為替市場でボラティリティーや相関性が高まっているとして、リスク評価や政策手段を強化すると表明した。

呉氏は、世界市場の関連性が強まっていることを踏まえ、証監会として国内外の市場を注視し、市場安定の仕組みを改善すると述べた。市場や部門を横断して波及するリスクに細心の注意を払う必要があると指摘。新たな業態などに伴うリスクへの備えを強化するほか、中国内の個別銘柄に連動するオフショアのレバレッジ商品に関しても警戒していくと言及した。

呉氏は、市場改革の一環として、上海証券取引所のハイテク企業向け市場「科創板（スター・マーケット）」と深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」を念頭に、テクノロジー企業の選定の仕組みを改善していくと述べた。中国の資本市場の新商品拡充策の一環として、１８のアクティブ運用型上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の登録承認についても明らかにした。

世界的な人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の売り圧力を受け、中国の主要指数ＣＳＩ３００指数は、足元では１０週連続で下落している。ハイテク株中心の「科創板」５０指数は６月下旬に付けた今年のピークから４０％近く下落し、年初来の上昇分を失った。

item.title: Nasdaq sube gracias al repunte de las acciones de IA y de chips
item.description: El índice Nasdaq, que tiene un gran componente tecnológico, lideró las subidas de Wall Street el lunes, ya que los inversionistas volvieron a apostar por el sector de los chips y otras acciones relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial tras la fuerte caída de la semana pasada y antes de la publicación de importantes reportes empresariales.
item.dc:creator: Sinead Carew, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: El índice Nasdaq, que tiene un gran componente tecnológico, lideró las subidas de Wall Street el lunes, ya que los inversionistas volvieron a apostar por el sector de los chips y otras acciones relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial tras la fuerte caída de la semana pasada y antes de la publicación de importantes reportes empresariales. Ambos índices habían cerrado el viernes con su mayor caída semanal desde finales de junio, ya que la preocupación de que el aumento de las tasas de interés pueda frenar las inversiones en infraestructuras de IA lastró a los valores tecnológicos, en particular a los operadores de centros de datos. La caída reflejó la creciente inquietud de los inversionistas sobre cómo se financiará la costosa expansión de la IA, una cuestión que ha ejercido una presión cada vez mayor sobre las empresas que sustentan el mercado alcista estadounidense, que recientemente cumplió cuatro años. El índice Philadelphia Semiconductor (.SOX) rompió una racha bajista de ocho días en la que había caído alrededor de un 15,7%, su serie de descensos más larga desde octubre de 2008. "Las bandas elásticas solo pueden estirarse hasta cierto punto en una dirección antes de romperse y empezar a revertirse, y finalmente se vio ese momento de 'ya basta' en el sector de los semiconductores tras el cierre del viernes", dijo Michael James, director general y operador de ventas de acciones en Rosenblatt Securities. "No cambió nada entre el cierre del viernes y la apertura de esta mañana, salvo que no ocurrió nada malo durante el fin de semana, y el ánimo se había vuelto tan negativo que estábamos en una situación de sobreventa tal que era inevitable un repunte", señaló James. Sin embargo, dado que en los próximos días y semanas se publicarán muchos reportes de resultados de empresas tecnológicas, advirtió de que el mercado está "lejos de haber salido del atolladero". Se espera que Meta (META.O) supere las expectativas de Wall Street cuando publique sus resultados el miércoles. El mismo día también se darán a conocer los resultados de Tesla (TSLA.O) , dirigida por Elon Musk, mientras que SpaceX (SPCX.O) tiene previsto publicar sus resultados el martes. Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 32,48 puntos, o un 0,42%, a 7.691,07 unidades, mientras que el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 290,85 puntos, o un 1,11%, a 26.430,89. El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cayó 32,21 puntos, o un 0,06%, a 51.970,20 unidades.

item.title: サウジ「砂漠のダボス会議」来年に延期、フーシ派攻撃で混乱続く
item.description:
Timour Azhari Federico Maccioni Tala Ramadan Alexander Cornwell
[１９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timour Azhari　Federico Maccioni　Tala Ramadan　Alexander Cornwell

[１９日　ロイター] - サウジアラビアで２６─２９日に開催予定だった国際投資会議「フューチャー・インベストメント・イニシアチブ（ＦＩＩ）」について、主催者は１９日、２０２７年に延期すると発表した。新たな日程は近く発表するとしている。

サウジでは中東紛争の拡大に伴う一連の攻撃で国内で死傷者が出る中、経済活動が混乱。ＦＩＩの主催者は声明で「参加者が期待するイベントの規模、卓越した質、そして忘れがたいインパクトを確実に提供したい」と延期理由を説明した。

ロイターは発表に先立ち、対面形式のイベントが中止されたと報じていた。

ＦＩＩは今回で１０回目。世界有数の金融関係者や企業経営者が集うイベントとして知られ、スイスで開かれる世界経済フォーラム（ＷＥＦ）年次総会になぞらえ、「砂漠のダボス会議」と呼ばれている。草案段階のプログラムによると、今年のＦＩＩには米ゴールドマン・サックスのデービッド・ソロモン会長兼最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）、英スタンダード・チャータードのビル・ウィンターズＣＥＯ、米シティグループのジェーン・フレイザーＣＥＯらが参加する予定だった。

米国とイランの交戦を受け、当初はアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）やカタールなどで予定されていた会議が中止や延期されることがあっても、サウジへの被害は比較的限定されていた。ただここ数週間、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジに対する攻撃を激化。フーシ派はサウジ各地の軍事施設、エネルギー関連施設、民間インフラを標的にしており、国営石油会社サウジアラムコの本社やリヤド国際空港も攻撃を受け、これまでに少なくとも１８人が死亡し、数百人が負傷した。

航空データ分析会社シリウムによると、８日以降にサウジ国内の空港から出発予定だった航空便の約４５％が欠航になっている。

item.title: 米住宅建設業者指数、10月は約14年半ぶり低水準 ローン金利・建材高が重し
item.description: [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 全米住宅建設業協会（ＮＡＨＢ）が１９日発表した１０月のＮＡＨＢ／ウェルズ・ファーゴ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米住宅建設業者指数、10月は約14年半ぶり低水準　ローン金利・建材高が重し 10/19 23:47 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスにある一戸建て住宅。８月撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake

[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 全米住宅建設業協会（ＮＡＨＢ）が１９日発表した１０月のＮＡＨＢ／ウェルズ・ファーゴ住宅建設業者指数は２９と、前月の３２から低下し、２０１２年６月以来、約１４年半ぶりの低水準となった。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は３１への低下だった。

中東紛争により住宅ローン金利とエネルギー関連の建材価格が上昇しているほか、移民取り締まりに伴う人手不足や、関税措置によるコスト上昇が影響している。

住宅ローン金利はここ数週間で急上昇しており、住宅金融公社フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローン金利は先週、７．４０％と約３年ぶりの高水準となった。米国とイスラエルの対イラン戦争がインフレをあおる中、米国債利回りに連動して借り入れコストが上昇し、住宅販売を圧迫している。

ＮＡＨＢのビル・オーウェンズ会長は「住宅建設業者は、建設ローンや建築建材、ディーゼル燃料のコスト上昇に加え、慢性的な人手不足にも直面している」と指摘。「全米で建設業者の３分の１超が、過去１カ月間に自社の事業地域で移民取り締まりの動きがあったと報告しており、これが建設の遅れや、合法的な労働者が出勤を躊躇（ちゅうちょ）する事態を招いている」と述べた。

買い手を呼び込むために値下げを実施した建設業者は４３％と、２０─２６年の期間で最も高い割合となった。平均値下げ幅は６％と横ばいだった。販売促進策の実施率は６５％。１９カ月連続で６０％以上となっている。

現在の販売状況を示す指数は２ポイント低下の３３。販売見通しを示す指数は５ポイント低下の３２となった。

見込み客の来場状況を示す指数は５ポイント低下の１８。ＮＡＨＢのチーフエコノミスト、ロバート・ディーツ氏は同指数について、コロナ禍の２０年４月を除くと、１２年４月以来の低水準だと指摘した。

item.title: ホルムズ不安定化「米に責任」、外国勢力伴わぬ安保必要＝イラン外相
item.description: [１９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１９日 ロイター] - イランのアラグチ外相は１９日、ロシアのラブロフ外相との共同記者会見で、ホルムズ海峡の不安定化と緊張の高まりは米国に責任があるとの認識を示し、地域問題は外交を通じて解決されなければならないと述べた。

アラグチ氏は「外国勢力の駐留を伴わず、地域内部から安全保障を実現するあらゆる取り組みを歓迎する。それが正しい方向性だと考えている」と述べ、地域諸国に対し共同の安全保障体制の構築に向けて取り組むよう呼びかけた。

ロシアのラブロフ外相はアラグチ氏との会談で、ロシアはエネルギー価格の大幅な変動に利益を見いだしていないとし、ロシアは長期的な視点で経済と国家の発展を計画する必要があると述べた。

item.title: 米国株式市場・午前＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック上昇、ＡＩ関連が反発
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １９日 ロイター］ - １９日午前の米国株式市場では、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が上昇した。人...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場・午前＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック上昇、ＡＩ関連が反発 10/19 23:33 配信

2026年7月20日に撮影 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

［ニューヨーク　１９日　ロイター］ - １９日午前の米国株式市場では、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が上昇した。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が前週の急落から反発したほか、原油価格の下落も支援材料となった。ナスダック総合指数は一時２５５．３ポイント（０．９８％）上昇した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手がけるコアウィーブは、投資判断の引き上げを受けて３．４％高と急伸した。

ゴールドマン・サックスは、同社の投資判断を「中立」から「買い」に引き上げた。コンピューティング能力の供給が逼迫していることや、競合企業に対する業績面での優位性から、今後２年間でメガワット当たりの年間経常収益が押し上げられるはずだとし、直近の下落は買いの好機だとした。前週には、同社の抱える５００億ドルの債務を巡る懸念がＡＩセクター全体に広がり、株価の４分の１超を失っていた。

競合のネビウス・グループは４．５％高。過去２週間で３１％超下落していた。データセンター運営のアプライド・デジタルは９％、ＩＲＥＮは５．７％、それぞれ上昇した。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は２．８％高で推移。前週に１１％超下落し、ＡＩ関連の急落局面で最も打撃を受けた銘柄群の一つとなった。

インテルは５．６％上昇した。ＪＰモルガンが投資判断を「アンダーウエート」から「ニュートラル」に引き上げたことが材料となった。

エヌビディアは０．６％、ＡＭＤは４．３％、ブロードコムは２．２％、それぞれ上昇した。３社とも前週に大きく売られていた。

マイクロン・テクノロジーは３．８％高。前週には約１５％下落していた。データストレージのサンディスク、ウエスタン・デジタル、シーゲイトも前週の大幅安から反発した。

Ex-OpenAI employee accused of planting device appears to have Saudi backing, US prosecutors say

A handout photo shows what the US Justice Department says is Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi national employed as an OpenAI engineer, checking a hidden audio recording device in an executive conference room at the AI company, at a location given as San Francisco, California, US, October 5, 2026. US Department of Justice/Handout via REUTERS

A device, which the US Justice Department says is a hidden audio recording device installed in an OpenAI executive conference room by Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi national employed as an engineer at the AI company, at a location given as San Francisco, California, US, in this combination handout photo released October 13, 2026. US Department of Justice/Handout via REUTERS THIS IMAGE HAS BEEN SUPPLIED BY A THIRD PARTY

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : An ex-OpenAI engineer accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at the AI company appears to have received considerable support from the Saudi government, US prosecutors said in a court filing. Federal prosecutors allege that the defendant, Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, was in frequent communication with an unnamed member of the Saudi royal family and that a Saudi military official paid for a one-way plane ticket for Alfozan's wife and young son to return to Saudi Arabia after his arrest, according to the court document, made public late on Sunday. Prosecutors made those allegations as they asked a federal judge to keep Alfozan in US custody to await trial, arguing he is a flight risk. Alfozan, a Saudi national and lawful permanent resident in the US, is scheduled to appear in federal court in San Francisco later on Monday.  The case has highlighted security challenges around sensitive AI research as companies and governments compete fiercely for an edge in the transformational technology.

"The defendant went to significant lengths to create customized, encrypted recording devices to secretly record highly sensitive meetings involving senior OpenAI personnel and executives, high-level business counterparts, and government officials, all while communicating with individuals of significance in Saudi Arabia and pursuing opportunities in — and making plans to travel to — Saudi Arabia," prosecutors wrote in a detention memo. The Saudi government media office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A lawyer for Alfozan did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The lawyer, William Pernik, previously asked for Alfozan to be released from custody, subject to conditions including location monitoring and surrendering his passport, and said Alfozan had spent the last 15 years in the US and had applied to become a citizen. The lawyer said a planned trip by Alfozan to Saudi Arabia this month was booked before he was under investigation and was for "family and immigration reasons," according to a court filing. DEVICE INSTALLED BEHIND TV US prosecutors charged Alfozan last week with using an electronic device to intercept oral communications. Alfozan plugged a recording device into the back of a television in an executive conference room at one of OpenAI's San Francisco buildings, according to a criminal complaint. Meetings involving government officials took place in the conference room around the time the device was installed, according to the prosecutors' detention memo.  Prosecutors said the investigation remains active and additional charges could be brought against Alfozan. A member of the Saudi royal family sought to recruit Alfozan for an AI-focused role in Saudi Arabia, writing in one message, “Saudi needs you more then the US!" Alfozan replied "100," according to messages cited by prosecutors. Before his arrest, Alfozan was scheduled to fly to Riyadh during a planned two-month parental leave. His wife told investigators that she and their son planned to move permanently to Saudi Arabia and that Alfozan eventually intended to join them, according to prosecutors. In an Arabic-language interview on the Identity Capital podcast last month, Alfozan said that he visits Saudi Arabia three or four times a year, follows developments there and advises or mentors Saudi startups. He said meeting Prince Mohammed bin Salman, then deputy crown prince, during a 2016 gathering with young Saudi tech workers in Silicon Valley persuaded him to learn at a top tech company before bringing those skills back home. While Alfozan was working at Facebook, he and other Saudis in Silicon Valley formed a consulting initiative that linked Saudi public- and private-sector organizations with expertise in big data, the internet of things and machine learning. OpenAI previously said it discovered the device on September 30 and referred the matter to the FBI.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米、中国ディープシークを民生部門ＩＴから排除 情報流出懸念
item.description: [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　１９日　ロイター] - 米国土安全保障省（ＤＨＳ）は、米政府の民生部門のＩＴシステムから、中国の新興人工知能（ＡＩ）企業ディープシークの製品および同社製モデルを使用した第三者サービスの排除を命じている。１９日に公表された通知から明らかになった。

同省はまた、米政府の民生部門によるディープシーク製品およびディープシークを用いて開発された第三者サービスの調達も禁止する。同省は、ディープシークのモデルは「複数の脅威の経路」をもたらすと指摘。米政府職員や取引業者が使用した場合、「機密データが中国に流出する可能性がある」との懸念を示した。

さらに、政府機関によるディープシークの利用は「米国民や政府機関に関し、具体的な工作につながる機密情報を生み出す可能性がある。モデル自体にマルウエアやその他のセキュリティー上の脆弱性が含まれている恐れがある」と指摘した。

ＤＨＳは１９日に公表された７月付のメモで、ディープシークに関する潜在的なリスクに対処するため、政府ウェブサイトを出入りするトラフィックの流れを監視するよう連邦機関に指示した。

これまでに米商務省や海軍を含む複数の機関が、政府支給の端末でのディープシークの使用を禁止しているほか、ニューヨーク、テネシー、バージニア各州など複数の州も同様の措置を講じている。

在ワシントンの中国大使館はコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 19 : Nvidia has won central processor chip business with another fast-growing AI startup that until now relied entirely on chips from Intel and AMD, an early sign that its push into a market long controlled by those two rivals has traction. Modal, a cloud-computing startup that rents out computing power to AI developers, said it plans to start using Nvidia's new Vera central processor for the first time for hosting agents, the AI systems that can carry out long-running tasks for human users. Modal until now has run such work only on Intel and AMD chips. Modal last week raised $750 million in a funding round led by Accel at a $15.75 billion valuation, saying it is on track to record $1 billion in sales over the next year. Modal said usage of its services has tripled and revenue has grown more than 15 times year-over-year. Modal said Monday that early tests showed the new Nvidia chip doubled the amount of work that AI agents can get done, prompting the company to support Nvidia's chip design for the first time, which will require some deep software changes on Modal's side.

But Chief Executive Erik Bernhardsson was careful to stress it is not abandoning its existing suppliers. The company said it will run the Nvidia chips alongside its current Intel and AMD offerings in a mixed fleet, putting each job on whatever hardware runs it best. Bernhardsson said the tests were run against the Intel and AMD chips already on the market. Both Nvidia rivals are developing newer models that could narrow the gap with Nvidia. "We'll test them when they're available," he said, adding that running a mixed setup means the company "can always deploy whatever hardware performs best." Nvidia has told investors it expects to generate at least $20 billion from Vera chip sales this fiscal year, its opening bid for a market it values at roughly $200 billion. Nvidia has previously said OpenAI, Anthropic and Oracle also plan to use the chips, along with AI startups such as Perplexity.

Source: Reuters

item.title: パリやニースなどに夜間外出禁止令、首相が極左勢力の暴動関与を非難
item.description: [パリ １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ １９日 ロイター] - フランス当局は１９日、首都パリや北部リール、南部ニースなど複数の都市の一部地域に夜間外出禁止令を発令した。週末に行われた全国的なデモが暴動や略奪に発展し、政府は治安対策の不備を巡って対応を迫られている。

ルコルニュ首相は、一部地域で夜間外出禁止令を出すよう地方当局に要請していた。首相は、パリ全域を対象とする全面的な夜間外出禁止令は否定したが、非常事態宣言については排除しなかった。ただ、現段階では部分的かつ地域限定の夜間外出禁止令の方がより適切との考えを示していた。

パリ警察によると、首都の一部地域で１９日午後８時（１８００ＧＭＴ、日本時間２０日午前３時）からデモを禁止する命令を出したほか、レピュブリック広場とレアールの周辺で午後１１時から夜間外出禁止令を発令した。いずれも２０日午前６時まで適用される。警察は声明で「これらの措置の厳格な順守を確保するため、警察部隊を配置している」と表明した。

首相府関係者によると、北部のリール、ドゥエー、ワティニー、ドゥナンでは、各市長の同意を得て、未成年者を対象に午後８時から翌朝午前６時までの夜間外出禁止令を２日間にわたり実施する。

ニースのエリック・シオッティ市長はインターネットに投稿した動画で、市中心部で未成年者の夜間外出を禁止する命令に署名したと述べた。

マルセイユは集会とデモを禁止した。一方、フランスの労働組合は１１月５日に新たなストライキと集会を実施するよう呼びかけた。

数週間にわたる学生デモに続き、１７日には、生活費の高騰と公共サービスの質の低下に抗議するデモが一部で暴徒化し、過去数十年で同国最大規模の暴動に発展した。

商業・小売連盟によると、週末に被害を受けた店舗は約３０００店に上っている。

次期大統領選まで半年に迫るフランスを揺るがし、経済の低迷と債務の急増による圧力を浮き彫りにした。

＜首相、極左を非難＞

またルコルニュ首相は、今回の騒乱の一部について極左グループの関与を非難。「大統領選を前に、国内に深刻な混乱を引き起こそうとする極左の動きが確かに存在する。これ以上強い言い方はできない」と述べた。

これに対し、極左政党「不屈のフランス（ＬＦＩ）」を率いるジャンリュック・メランション氏は強く反発。ルコルニュ首相に対し証拠を示すよう求め、「さもなくば謝罪し、沈黙し、騒乱の火に油を注ぐのをやめるべきだ」とＸに投稿した。

フランス大統領選の世論調査では、メランション氏と極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の実質的な指導者マリーヌ・ルペン氏が他の候補者に対するリードを広げ、決選投票で一騎打ちになるとの見通しが示されている。

週末の暴動や略奪の爪痕が残る中、フランスの主要都市の市長らは１９日、治安部隊の準備が不足していたとして政府に説明を求めた。

パリ、マルセイユ、リヨンの市長は仏紙リベラシオンへの共同寄稿で、デモや抗議行動への対応には慣れているとしながらも、「１７日には初めて、われわれの都市の広い範囲が保護されずに放置されたと感じた」と記した。

１９日から学校の休暇が始まることで事態が落ち着く可能性はあるが、パリ中心部のルーブル美術館やパリ政治学院などでは、学生が集会や封鎖を続けていた。

Erlangen, GERMANY, Oct 19 : AI could help preserve manufacturing jobs in high-wage countries such as Germany by boosting factory automation to as much as 80 per cent, Siemens executive board member Cedrik Neike said on Monday. Speaking at the company's electronics plant in Erlangen, Neike said manufacturers need annual productivity gains of 7 per cent-9 per cent to remain competitive. • Siemens aims to harness AI to raise the level of automation in factory manufacturing to 70 per cent-80 per cent from 30 per cent-40 per cent currently, Neike said. • Siemens and Nvidia are working on the use of "physical AI" in manufacturing, using digital twins and AI models to simulate and optimise factory operations before they are deployed on the factory floor.

item.title: 米ロ中首脳、ＡＰＥＣ首脳会議に合わせ会談の可能性＝ロシア大統領報道官
item.description: [モスクワ １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ　１９日　ロイター] - ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官は１９日、プーチン大統領、トランプ米大統領、中国の習近平国家主席が来月中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせて３者会談を行う可能性があるとの見方を示し、そうした会談について協議で言及されたと明らかにした。

ペスコフ大統領報道官は、ロシアとウクライナの戦闘終結に向けた協議を行うため、プーチン氏が米ロ中の首脳会談を提案したとする米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）の報道について質問され、「３首脳全員が中国で開かれる首脳会議に参加する可能性があることを踏まえ、そうした会談の可能性が実際に話題に上った」とした上で、「実際に議題に上ったが、会談そのものや会談の議題、内容について具体的な提案や合意が協議されたり、提示されたりしていない」と述べた。

また、米国はロシアとウクライナの戦闘終結に向けた仲介努力を続けており、ロシアはその取り組みを評価していると指摘。最終的な和平合意にはウクライナの参加が不可欠との認識を示した。

米ロ中首脳会談の可能性についてルビオ米国務長官は１９日、訪問先のウズベキスタンで記者団に対し「会談の話は出ている。最終決定したかどうかは分からないが、トランプ大統領の意向は明確だ。大統領はウクライナとロシア間の戦争が終わることを望んでいる」と述べている。

ウクライナのシビハ外相は、米ロ中の首脳による会談の構想を非難。「ウクライナ、米国、ロシアの首脳による３者会談なら、戦争終結の早期実現の一助になり得る。ロシア、中国、米国の首脳による３者会談はその逆の効果しかなく、プーチン氏が戦争を継続することを後押しするだけだ」とＸに投稿した。

item.title: イエメン暫定政府の訓練施設攻撃で53人死亡、フーシ派が犯行声明
item.description: [１９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１９日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は１９日、同国中南部シャブワ州にある暫定政府治安部隊の訓練施設を攻撃し、５３人が死亡、２００人が負傷した。地元当局が明らかにした。貧困にあえぐ同国での戦闘が激化している。

フーシ派のヤヒヤ・サリー報道官はＸへの投稿で、同派が訓練施設を標的にしたと表明。同施設はサウジアラビア軍が運営していたと主張した。サウジ当局はコメント要請に即座には応じなかった。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた地元当局筋によると、フーシ派は訓練中の治安部隊に向け、弾道ミサイル３発を発射した。シャブワ州はイエメン中南部沿岸に位置するエネルギー資源が豊富な州で、同国最大の産業投資であるバルハフ液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）施設がある。

イエメン暫定政府軍は今月、フーシ派が支配する地域の奪還を目指す作戦を開始し、バベルマンデブ海峡付近の領土を取り戻した。一方、フーシ派は、イエメン南部山岳地帯における反フーシ派勢力の最後の主要都市拠点であるタイズを包囲している。

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : Meta apologized for suspending the Instagram account of the "No Kings" protest movement over the weekend, attributing the shutdown to a sharp increase in activity that looked like automated bot traffic rather than human exchanges. Demonstrators gathered at thousands of events across the United States on Saturday decrying President Donald Trump's aggressive deportation efforts, war in Iran and other policies in the third round of the "No Kings" rallies. The Instagram account used by organizers and attendees, however, was offline for more than an hour. And Meta spokesman Andy Stone wrote in a post on X that it took longer to fix problems with organizers' access to the accounts.  Stone said network security systems detected the use of a Claude tool reading profiles, posts, and hashtags, with the rate sharply increasing in intense bursts on October 17.

"These abrupt, high-volume, sequential requests in a short period resembled automated bot traffic rather than an ordinary human browsing our systems. This activity caused our automated protections to incorrectly take the No Kings Instagram account offline," he said. "We want to reiterate our sincere apology for the error." Rally organizers were not satisfied on Monday. "Meta's explanation still doesn't add up," the No Kings Coalition said on the Bluesky platform. "Beyond shutting down our Instagram, we’ve received reports that NoKings and early voting content was inaccessible, restricted, or seemed suppressed across Meta platforms."  "Weeks before an election, an apology isn't enough. The public needs answers, accountability, and concrete safeguards," the coalition said. "No Kings" rallies took place in cities from Seattle and San Diego to Chicago, Atlanta and New York. In Washington, DC, protesters gathered at the site of Trump's proposed triumphal arch to encourage early voting before the November 3 midterm congressional elections.

Supreme Court rejects Google challenge to US patent agency review policy

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : The US Supreme Court declined on Monday to hear a challenge by Alphabet's Google to a US Patent and Trademark Office rule that the company argued has insulated older patents from validity reviews and helped fuel a surge in patent litigation. The justices turned away Google's appeal of a lower court's decision not to force the agency to reconsider, without using its "settled expectations" rule, the company's challenge to the validity of a patent held by software company VirtaMove. VirtaMove accused Google of infringing the patent. Google asked the Supreme Court to review the "settled expectations" policy, under which the patent office's Patent Trial and Appeal Board, or PTAB, became more likely to reject requests to review patents that have been in force for more than six years. Technology companies often use the board's "inter partes review" process to try to cancel patents that they are accused of infringing. The three most active board petitioners between 2020 and 2025 were Samsung, Apple and Alphabet, according to a report from IP company Patexia.

The USPTO during President Donald Trump's administration has introduced measures that have decreased the percentage of reviews the board takes up.  That figure fell to 37 per cent in 2026 under John Squires, the Trump appointee who heads the patent office, compared to 65 per cent under his predecessor Kathi Vidal, who was appointed by former President Joe Biden, according to an April report from the agency. The patent office outlined in a memo last year several factors that favor rejecting an inter partes review petition, which the agency has used to deny review for patents that are more than six years old based on the "settled expectations" of the parties. The patent office cited the "settled expectations" rule in rejecting Google's review petition in 2025 concerning the VirtaMove patent involving server software. The US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit ruled against Google's appeal of the patent office rejection. Google told the justices in a filing that the rule exceeds the patent office's authority by creating an artificial time limit for board petitions. "The PTO (Patent and Trademark Office) has no authority to create a limitations period where Congress did not, and it has no authority to expand patent rights beyond what Congress provided," Google said in the filing. The Trump administration urged the court not to hear Google's appeal. A group of companies including Google, Apple and Intel has filed a separate lawsuit challenging a related patent office policy. The Federal Circuit ruled against the companies in February, and Intel and Google have also asked the Supreme Court to hear that case.

Source: Reuters

item.title: US Supreme Court will not review Trump's firing of labor board member
item.description: The US Supreme Court declined on Monday to hear a bid by a Democratic-appointed member of the National Labor Relations Board to challenge the legality of her firing by President Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: John Kruzel
item.content:encoded: The US Supreme Court declined on Monday to hear a bid by a Democratic-appointed member of the National Labor Relations Board to challenge the legality of her firing by President Donald Trump . The justices turned away former NLRB member Gwynne Wilcox's appeal of a lower court's ruling that said the Republican president's January 2025 firing of her was a valid exercise of executive authority. The court's action follows its June decision [USN:S0N3YR013 TEXT:"backing Trump's firing"] of Rebecca Slaughter, a Democratic Federal Trade Commission member. That ruling overturned the court's 1935 precedent in a case called Humphrey's Executor that had recognized the authority of Congress to protect leaders of certain regulatory agencies from presidential removal at will. The Slaughter decision capped a decades-long conservative push to strengthen the president's grip on key levers of government power. Trump's move to oust Wilcox from the NLRB was part of his shakeup and downsizing of the US government, including firing thousands of workers, dismantling federal agencies, installing loyalists in key jobs and purging career officials. "I'm disappointed that the Supreme Court has declined to hear this case, not only for myself, but also for the workers and employers who rely on the National Labor Relations Board to resolve labor disputes impartially and free from political pressure," Wilcox said in a statement. Wilcox added that she would remain committed to "protecting the principles that allow the board to serve the public fairly." The Justice Department declined to comment. Wilcox, the first Black woman to serve on the agency's board, was appointed to a second five-year term in 2023 by Democratic former President Joe Biden. Trump moved to fire her about a week into his second presidential term, drawing a lawsuit by Wilcox. Slaughter also was a Biden appointee. The legal fight over Trump's firing of Wilcox and other officials has figured as a key test of his efforts to bring federal agencies meant by Congress to be independent from the president under his control. US District Judge Beryl Howell in March 2025 upheld a federal law protecting NLRB officials from being fired without cause, rejecting Trump's argument that the measure passed by Congress encroaches on authority granted to the president under the US Constitution. That ruling was reversed in a 2-1 decision by the US Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit in December 2025, prompting Wilcox's appeal to the Supreme Court.

item.title: US Supreme Court to hear Maryland case involving race in school admissions
item.description: The US Supreme Court agreed on Monday to consider reviving a lawsuit against a Maryland county's lottery admissions policy for four elite public middle schools that some parents claim unlawfully discriminates against Asian American applicants.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chung
item.content:encoded: The US Supreme Court agreed on Monday to consider reviving a lawsuit against a Maryland county's lottery admissions policy for four elite public middle schools that some parents claim unlawfully discriminates against Asian American applicants. Delving again into the contentious issue of race in student admissions, the justices took up an appeal by a coalition of parents of a lower court's decision rejecting their claim that Montgomery County's policy violates the US Constitution's 14th Amendment guarantee of equal protection under the law. The Supreme Court is expected to hear the case and rule by the end of June. The parents sued to challenge the entrance policies for the county's academically rigorous "magnet" schools, which provide enrichment programs in math and science, or the humanities, for high-achieving students in sixth through eighth grades. They include Takoma Park Middle School in Silver Spring and Martin Luther King Jr. Middle School in Germantown. The case represents the latest legal attack on entrance policies at certain highly selective public schools that challengers critique for continuing to pursue "racial balancing" with the aim of boosting diversity. The Supreme Court issued a landmark 2023 [USN:S0N31105H TEXT:"ruling"] that rejected [USN:L1N38L2JO TEXT:"race-conscious"] college and university admissions policies long used to raise the number of Black, Hispanic and other minority students on campuses. Plaintiffs in these new legal challenges claim that admissions to these prestigious programs, though race-neutral on the surface, use proxies such as socioeconomic status to achieve the same unlawful, race-based result in pursuit of diversity. The legal challenges coincide with President Donald Trump 's policies, implemented since he returned to office last year, against diversity, equity and inclusion, or DEI, programs in education, as well as in the US government and military, and in private companies. At issue in the Maryland case is whether lower courts may dismiss claims of intentional racial discrimination if the policy has not disproportionately harmed that racial group, in this instance Asian American students. Montgomery County is a wealthy suburb of Washington, DC. The parent coalition, called the Association for Education Fairness, is represented by the Pacific Legal Foundation, a libertarian legal group that has pursued similar challenges in Virginia and Massachusetts. The Supreme Court [USN:S0N3AA01J TEXT:"rejected"] those [USN:S0N3IS01A TEXT:"cases"] in 2024. "The Constitution protects students as individuals, not as members of a racial group," said Chris Kieser, an attorney for the coalition. "A school district should not be able to defeat a discrimination claim by showing that its policy did not harm enough Asian American children. Every family deserves admissions rules that judge their child on their own merit," Kieser said. A spokesperson for Montgomery County Public Schools said the school district "remains committed to providing equitable access to rigorous opportunities for all students. This commitment will continue uninterrupted as the judicial process proceeds." ENRICHED INSTRUCTION The Montgomery County school district's selection process was introduced in the 2021-2022 school year, during the COVID-19 pandemic. It screens all students for academic potential, and then implements a lottery to randomly assign students from that pool to receive enriched instruction at either a magnet school or a local school. The lawsuit said that the lottery system led to a lower number of Asian American student placements at the magnet schools. The suit alleged that the screening process makes it harder for Asian American students, who the challengers said are clustered in "high-performing, low-poverty elementary schools," to enter the lottery pool. Part of the process ranks a student's performance by comparing the student's test scores against those of other students whose family incomes are at a similar level. US District Judge Paula Xinis threw out the case in 2022, finding that the policy did not place a disproportionate burden on Asian American students. The judge noted that the percentage of admitted Asian American students exceeded the percentage of Asian Americans among all applicants to the magnet schools. Xinis also found that there was no evidence that the lottery policy was implemented with discriminatory intent. The Richmond, Virginia-based 4th US Circuit Court of Appeals upheld the dismissal, agreeing that the lawsuit "does not plausibly allege that the challenged policy disparately impacts Asian American students." The Supreme Court's 2023 affirmative action ruling upended decades of precedent, striking down programs used by Harvard University and the University of North Carolina that took race into account as one of many factors in student admissions evaluations.

item.title: Trump signs order creating NIH division, task force for women's health
item.description: US President Donald Trumpsigned an executive order alongside first lady Melania Trump on Monday creating a White House task force and a National Institutes of Health division focused on women's health.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Ahmed Aboulenein
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump signed an executive order alongside first lady Melania Trump on Monday creating a White House task force and a National Institutes of Health division focused on women's health. The task force will be led by White House chief of staff Susie Wiles, who recently announced that she is [USN:FWN4580F5 TEXT:"cancer-free"], and Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., Trump said at a White House event. It directs the federal government to pursue a comprehensive approach to women's health across all life stages, strengthening research to speed up prevention, diagnosis, and treatment and translating those findings into clinical practice and policy, according to a White House fact sheet. The task force will hold its first meeting on Monday, Trump said, during what he noted was Breast Cancer Awareness Month. Wiles recently finished treatment for breast cancer. "The executive order I'll sign in just a moment will direct the Department of Health and Human Services to establish a new women's health division within the National Institute of Health," Trump said at the event. "That's a big deal. They've been after it for a long time," he said. "Who the hell wouldn't have a woman's health division? Melania said they don't have it." The NIH has an Office of Research on Women's Health, established in 1990. The new division will operate in coordination with that office rather than replace it, and must be established within an appropriate NIH institute or center within 90 days, according to the order. The White House said the move is meant to broaden the government's focus beyond research and prioritize translating discoveries into clinical care for women and girls. It will focus on speeding up diagnosis and improving treatment of women's health conditions that remain understudied, boosting the inclusion of women and girls in clinical trials, and holding grant recipients accountable for considering sex as a biological variable. CONDITIONS AFFECTING WOMEN DISPROPORTIONATELY The division will study conditions that uniquely or disproportionately affect women, including cardiovascular disease, cancer, autoimmune and inflammatory conditions, chronic pain, endometriosis, fibroids, polyendocrine metabolic ovary syndrome, infertility, menopause, Alzheimer's disease and osteoporosis, the Department of Health and Human Services said in a statement. The order was first reported by USA Today. Melania Trump, whom Trump credited with conceiving the initiative, said the effort should "ensure that medical breakthroughs are accessible and affordable to women, regardless of their financial circumstances" and "replace generations of silence with open conversation, education and compassion." Trump and his administration have pushed for [USN:S0N40B08H TEXT:"healthcare cuts"], including at [USN:L1N3Y60W8 TEXT:"NIH"], and last year moved to downsize the federal healthcare workforce. During Trump's second term, his administration sought to cut NIH grants for [USN:S0N3RR046 TEXT:"research on diversity-related"] topics and reportedly is moving to allow [USN:L6N45C00H TEXT:"political appointees"] to control health-research funding. The order revokes former President Joe Biden's March 2024 executive order on advancing women's health research, which was championed by then-first lady Jill Biden, as well as a November 2023 memorandum that created a White House initiative on the issue. The Trump administration has also launched a [USN:FWN42C0QU TEXT:"safety review"] of the abortion pill, mifepristone, that could pave the way for restrictions. Major medical groups have criticized the move as politically motivated while anti-abortion groups argue the review is moving too slowly. Earlier this month, US officials told a court the review would be completed by [USN:L1N45O0U4 TEXT:"March"]. US health officials also [USN:L4N3WM195 TEXT:"removed a longstanding safety warning"] from many hormone replacement therapy products, [USN:L4N4241L1 TEXT:"tightening supplies"] and leading to [USN:L6N45L119 TEXT:"shortages"], and have urged more manufacturers to study [USN:L1N4590J9 TEXT:"testosterone therapies for women"] that could support future approvals of female-specific products. HHS has also targeted family planning funds, announcing earlier this year that for the first time it would require applicants for Title X funding to align their programs with Trump's political priorities, prompting [USN:L1N44O0N6 TEXT:"legal action"].

item.title: US banning Chinese AI DeepSeek from government agency IT systems
item.description: The US Homeland Security Department is ordering the removal of DeepSeek products and third-party services using the Chinese AI model from US civilian agency IT systems, according to a notice published Monday.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The US Homeland Security Department is ordering the removal of DeepSeek products and third-party services using the Chinese AI model from US civilian agency IT systems, according to a notice published Monday. The department is also banning acquisition of DeepSeek products and third-party services developed using DeepSeek by US civilian government agencies. DHS said DeepSeek models pose "multiple threat vectors" and raised concerns that use of the product "may result in the transfer of sensitive data to the PRC if used by US government employees or vendors." DHS also said use of DeepSeek by government agencies "could produce actionable intelligence on US persons and/or government agencies. The models themselves may contain malware or other security vulnerabilities." In a July memo made public Monday, DHS told federal agencies to monitor flows of traffic in and out of government websites to address potential risks from DeepSeek. Previously, several US agencies, including the Department of Commerce and the Navy, have banned the use of DeepSeek on government devices. Multiple states including New York, Tennessee, and Virginia have taken similar steps. The Chinese Embassy in Washington did not immediately comment. The Trump administration has taken a series of steps to crack down on Chinese tech companies. The Federal Communications Commission will vote on October 29 to bar all Chinese labs from testing electronic devices such as smartphones, cameras and computers for use in the US. Last year, 82% of US electronics were tested in China. In December, the FCC banned import of all new models of Chinese drones and also banned imports of new models of Chinese-made consumer routers, the boxes connecting computers, phones and smart devices to the internet. In July, the FCC voted to bar sales of devices in the US that contain key hardware from Chinese companies deemed to be national security risks and has proposed to prohibit US telecommunications carriers from interconnecting with Chinese telecom firms deemed national security risks.

item.title: UK risks becoming 'AI customer' rather than creator, advisers warn
item.description: Britain risks becoming a "high-value AI customer" rather than a country able to shape the technology unless it takes urgent action to build domestic capabilities, the government's top science advisers said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Sam Tabahriti
item.content:encoded: Britain risks becoming a "high-value AI customer" rather than a country able to shape the technology unless it takes urgent action to build domestic capabilities, the government's top science advisers said on Monday. Governments around the world are racing to build AI capabilities, driven by concerns that countries without their own expertise, computing infrastructure and models could become increasingly dependent on a handful of mostly U.S.-based companies that dominate the technology. The Council for Science and Technology, an independent advisory body that advises the government on science and technology policy, said decisions made now would determine whether Britain captures the economic and public benefits of AI while maintaining resilience and strategic autonomy. "The way for us to achieve AI sovereignty is to build trusted systems that deliver real public, economic and security benefits," the advisers said in an emailed letter to the AI minister, Kanishka Narayan. The council warned that Britain was at risk of falling behind and becoming a "high-value AI customer, rather than a country able to shape the technology and its usage," without what it described as "deliberate and urgent action." It recommended appointing a single government lead to coordinate AI sovereignty policy, investing in skills, data and computing infrastructure, and testing AI systems in areas including national security, health and education. The advisers also said Britain should maintain access to the world's most advanced AI systems while developing some domestic capabilities of its own, including exploring a publicly governed British AI model that could be made available to researchers, startups and public services. The government did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: France's unrest lays bare 'slow agony' of Macron's twilight months
item.description: France’s worst bout of civil unrest in years has plunged President Emmanuel Macron’s final months in office deeper into turmoil, exposing the powerlessness of a leader struggling to contain social anger with little money to spend, scant political capital and an increasingly fragile grip on public order.
item.dc:creator: Michel Rose
item.content:encoded: France’s worst bout of civil unrest in years has plunged President Emmanuel Macron’s final months in office deeper into [USN:FWN4630KA TEXT:"turmoil"], exposing the powerlessness of a leader struggling to contain social anger with little money to spend, scant political capital and an increasingly fragile grip on public order. The [USN:L1N46302B TEXT:"rioting"] that swept across France on Saturday, leaving a trail of looted shops, torched buildings and defaced public institutions, presents Macron with perhaps the most explosive challenge of his twilight presidency: a country demanding more from a state that can no longer afford to give much. Macron came to power almost a decade ago promising to upend France’s sclerotic political class, turbocharge economic reforms and restore authority through a more assertive presidency. Instead, with just six months left in office, he finds himself effectively a lame-duck head of state presiding over a country mired in political paralysis, facing acute [USN:L6N46502R TEXT:"financial pressures"] and grappling with unrest that has exposed the limits of state authority. Unlike during the Yellow Vest uprising of 2018-2019, when Macron sought to defuse public anger with billions of euros in concessions, France’s strained public finances and fractured parliament leave him with precious few levers to pull. Even former allies are now openly scathing, tracing the country's current impasse to Macron's decision to call a [USN:L8N3J00J1 TEXT:"snap parliamentary election"] in 2024 that weakened his authority. “The end of this term is a slow agony,” said Loïc Kervran, a former lawmaker from Macron’s camp, on X. “The president paralysed the country with his absurd decision to dissolve parliament in 2024. Arguably the worst decision in the history of the Fifth Republic." LE PEN'S 'HIGHWAY' TO THE PRESIDENCY The turmoil may benefit far-right National Rally leader Marine Le Pen, who is already the frontrunner in the 2027 presidential race and stands to gain from both the anger over declining living standards and the fears over law and order unleashed by the weekend’s violence. "Le Pen no longer needs to spend any money to campaign," Jean-Baptiste Moreau, another former Macron lawmaker, told Reuters. "It's not just a clear path ahead of her — it's a six-lane highway." Le Pen delivered her own message to the nation in a video statement on Sunday, portraying Macron's administration as a crumbling power and casting herself as the figure capable of restoring order. When Macron later addressed the country, he offered little concrete action, stopping short of declaring a state of emergency. As he spoke, looting was continuing for a second consecutive night, including in affluent Paris districts, prompting his prime minister Sébastien Lecornu to announce local curfews on Monday. Opponents and one-time allies alike were underwhelmed. His former prime minister, Edouard Philippe, now preparing his own presidential run, was unsparing in his criticism. "Mr President, I listened to you last night," he wrote on X. "I would have preferred, like millions of French people, decisions and initiatives to restore order." "Our country needs to be commanded," he added. But even Philippe is struggling to shake off his past association with Macron, and most recent polls show far-left firebrand Jean-Luc Melenchon edging ahead of him in the race to qualify for the second-round runoff vote. That outcome would all but guarantee a Le Pen victory, according to opinion polls. CALLS FOR EARLY RESIGNATION AMID MULTIPLE CRISES Macron's office on Monday announced that he had refused his interior minister's resignation and ordered a review into apparent failures in intelligence gathering and police preparedness — deepening the impression of a government struggling to regain control. [USN:L1N465097 TEXT:"Investors also took fright"]. Market analysts say the violence adds another layer of political risk at a time when France is already under scrutiny over its swelling debt burden and struggle to reduce one of the euro zone's largest budget deficits. The president now finds himself trapped between bond markets demanding spending restraint and protesters demanding the opposite. Despite calls from opponents to remain in France, Macron arrived in Kuwait on Monday on a Gulf tour he says will help secure fuel supplies and ease some of the economic pressures that have helped swell the ranks of the protesters. The trip carries risks, reinforcing perceptions of a president disconnected from the public mood. Images of Macron attending a Céline Dion concert with his wife Brigitte on Friday evening, hours before the unrest erupted, prompted ridicule on social media and became an easy symbol for critics seeking to portray him as detached from events. In a sign of the depth of disenchantment in parts of his political camp, some former allies have begun openly discussing whether he should leave office before the end of his term. Moreau, who spoke to Macron on Sunday, said he urged him to prepare an orderly early departure to break the current political deadlock and avoid another six months of drift. "He doesn't want to give up, that's not his character. But that's what he should do for the country," he said.

item.title: ジャカルタ株が過去2日で最大の下落、ＭＳＣＩに説明要求 市場改革も表明
item.description:
Ankur Banerjee Stefanno Sulaiman
[シンガポール／ジャカルタ １９日 ロイター] - ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ジャカルタ株が過去2日で最大の下落、ＭＳＣＩに説明要求　市場改革も表明 10/19 22:13 配信

株価ボード、ジャカルタのインドネシア証券取引所で16日撮影 REUTERS/Ajeng Dinar Ulfiana/File Photo

Ankur Banerjee　Stefanno Sulaiman

[シンガポール／ジャカルタ １９日 ロイター] - インドネシア株式市場は１９日、２営業日の下落としては過去最大を記録した。指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩが１６日、２０２７年に同国を「新興国市場」から除外する可能性を警告したことが売りを誘発。当局はＭＳＣＩに説明を求めた。

ジャカルタ総合指数は１６日に１１．６％急落したのに続き、１９日は３．６％安で取引を終えた。２営業日の下落率は１９９８年のアジア金融危機時を含め過去最大となった。取引時間中には６年ぶりの安値も付けた。

ＭＳＣＩが１６日、インドネシアを「新興国市場」から「スタンドアローン市場」に変更することを検討していると表明したことで売りが始まった。想定以上に厳しい分類変更の可能性に、投資家や当局者に動揺が広がった。

スタンドアローン市場に変更されれば、東南アジア最大の経済規模を持つインドネシアは国際資本へのアクセスを失い、投資先として周縁に追いやられる恐れがある。

不安心理からの売りは通貨や債券市場にも波及した。ルピアは１ドル＝１万８０３０ルピアに下落、６月に付けた過去最安値の１万８１９０ルピアに迫った。国債も下落し、１０年債利回りは１６日の７．１６９％から７．４％に上昇した。

インドネシア証券取引所のジェフリー・ヘンドリック最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、説明を求めるためのＭＳＣＩとの会合を前に「（ＭＳＣＩから）このような発表があるとは予想していなかった。予想外の声明で市場はパニックに陥った」と述べた。

＜資本市場改革への取り組み継続＞

ヘンドリック氏はＭＳＣＩとのオンライン会合後、１月にＭＳＣＩが最初の警告を発したことを受けて着手した資本市場改革に引き続き取り組むと述べた。会合の詳細は明らかにできないとした。

同氏はまた、市場の透明性と価格発見機能を改善するための２つの施策を発表した。同一の個人や法人に株式保有が高度に集中している銘柄をジャカルタ総合指数から除外する措置が含まれる。「主要指数の動きをより正確に示す」ことが狙いという。

インドネシア証券取引所（ＩＤＸ）は１９日、価格変動の抑制に向け、株価の１日の下落率の上限を１５％から７％に縮小した。それを下回る価格での売り注文を自動的に拒否し、一段の下落を防ぐ。

＜投資家、インドネシア資産への投資を再評価＞

ＭＳＣＩの動きを受け、投資家がインドネシア資産全般への投資を見直す中、規制当局や財政・金融当局への圧力が強まっている。

かつて新興国市場の有望な投資先だった同国からの資本逃避リスクへの懸念も高まった。投資家によると、新型コロナウイルスのパンデミック以降、プラボウォ大統領の下で財政の健全性や中央銀行の独立性への信頼が薄れる中、同国の魅力は既に低下していた。

事情に詳しい政府当局者２人によると、プラボウォ氏は１９日、財政・金融当局者と会合を開き、「現在の経済情勢」について協議した。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングのソブリン担当アナリスト、レイン・リン氏は、ＭＳＣＩの最新の警告で追加の資本流出が起きる可能性が高いものの、資金調達コストを大幅に押し上げる規模にはならないとの見方を示した。「より懸念されるのは、投資家の信頼が損なわれる可能性と、国債市場や海外直接投資にも投資家心理の悪化が広く波及するリスクだ」と述べた。

ゴールドマン・サックスは、ＭＳＣＩ指数から完全に除外されれば、パッシブ運用資金が５６億ドル流出する可能性があると推計。これらの指数をベンチマークとするアクティブ運用ファンドの保有額は８０億ドルを超えるものの、売却するかどうかは指数への連動ではなく、運用者の裁量によると記した。

海外投資家は２６年に入り、インドネシア株を４９億８０００万ドル売り越している。年間の資金流出額は少なくとも過去１６年で最大となるペースだ。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード コラム：北朝鮮が韓国と対立姿勢、米国にとって新たな悩みの種に 焦点：新興国投資ラッシュに取り残されるインドネシア、強い政策への不信感 アングル：スマトラ島豪雨被害、森林破壊で被害拡大か　地元に怒りの声 アングル：石炭依存の東南アジア、長期電力購入契約がエネ移行の妨げに 最終更新: 10/19(月) 22:13 ロイター

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 19 : Amazon.com is introducing a new tool that allows its custom AI chips to run code written in the most popular AI coding language without modification, seeking to erode the advantage that underpins Nvidia's dominance in the AI computing market. Shares of the company were up 5 per cent in morning trading, with Morgan Stanley naming Amazon a "top pick". TorchNeuron lets developers run code written in a language called PyTorch on Amazon's Trainium AI chips with a single configuration change and no rewriting needed, according to Amazon's Annapurna Labs chip unit. Amazon, which plans to announce the software at a developer conference in Silicon Valley on Monday, said the software will be publicly released as a free and open-source offering.

PyTorch, the open-source framework stewarded by Meta, is used by most AI developers. Nvidia has spent more than a decade on its software tool called Cuda that makes PyTorch code run well on Nvidia chips. Other cloud computing players such as Google, which also has its own custom AI chips, are also working to lure away developers from Nvidia with better PyTorch tools. Colin Brace, vice president of software for Annapurna Labs, said the move was aimed at reducing the number of steps AI developers must take to try Amazon's in-house chips.  "This has been about meeting customers where they're at," he told Reuters in an interview.  Brace said more than 30 early customers — spanning robotics, world models and voice AI — are using the new software, and that the switch to Amazon's chips can result in steep cost savings.

OSLO, Oct 19 : Norway's planned social media ban for children will include provisions targeting "harmful platforms", the government said on Monday, naming messaging and gaming services Roblox, Snapchat and TikTok among those affected. The Nordic country said in April it would present a bill in parliament by the end of the year to ban children from using social media until they turn 16, making technology companies responsible for age verification. It did not name any platforms at the time. Several European nations are seeking to rein in children's social media use after Australia took the lead with the world's first ban on under-16s last December, which included apps such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube. Norway's government said in a statement on Monday that its bill was intended to address the full range of risks children face on social media and that it would affect "many platforms".

"This includes everything from exposure to harmful content and addictive features to illegal marketing and unwanted contact from strangers," Children and Families Minister Lene Vaagslid said in the statement. The planned legislation provides tech companies with an incentive to remove harmful content and addictive features, she said. The ministry went on to define what it called harmful platforms as "social media that, through its design, features or content, poses a risk to children's emotional, cognitive or physical development or safety." "The government believes that platforms such as TikTok, Roblox, and Snapchat will be covered by the law," it said. It did not immediately respond to a question about which other apps could be affected. Snap Inc, Roblox Corporation and TikTok owner ByteDance did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Children and young people will still have access to messaging services and games that are deemed harmless, the ministry said.

Source: Reuters
